prompt_cn: 一张静态、险恶的低角度镜头捕捉到了一个怪诞的立方体状凝胶状猎人，悬挂在深渊、漆黑的黑暗中。整个场景都充满了托德·麦克法兰画作中充满活力、锯齿状的能量，来自看不见光源的戏剧性背光从虚空中雕刻出了这个生物的威胁轮廓。猎人的核心是一个半透明的胆色果冻立方体，其表面潮湿地闪闪发光，其形状微妙地收缩和扩张，具有自己的生命力。从它的质量中，一团混乱的、肌肉发达的触手爆发出来，每一根触手都是一根黑色、静脉的肌肉，被拉紧并以包含的能量振动，准备果断地出击。这些附属物被渲染成尖锐、棱角分明的亮点和深邃的墨水状阴影，最终以甲壳状、锋利的倒刺结束。刺耳的背光穿透了凝胶状身体的边缘，透过其黑暗的内部折射，照亮了内部旋转、模糊的形状，创造了一种高对比度、可怕的螺旋式、迫在眉睫的暴力氛围。
prompt: static, menacing low-angle shot captures a grotesque, cube-shaped, gelatinous Hunter, suspended in abyssal, inky darkness. The entire scene is imbued with the vibrant, jagged energy of a Todd McFarlane painting, as dramatic backlighting from an unseen source carves the creature's menacing silhouette from the void. The Hunter's core is a translucent, bile-colored cube of jelly, its surface shimmering with moisture, its form subtly contracting and expanding with a life of its own. From its mass, a tangle of muscular tentacles erupts, each a black, veined muscle, taut and vibrating with contained energy, poised to strike decisively. These appendages are rendered in sharp, angular highlights and deep, inky shadows, culminating in carapace-like, razor-sharp barbs. The harsh backlight penetrates the edges of the gelatinous body, refracting through its dark interior to illuminate the swirling, blurred shapes within, creating a high-contrast, terrifying atmosphere of spiraling, imminent violence.

prompt_cn: 一个从低角度拍摄的慢动作镜头，镜头缓慢向右平移，追踪着两只在洒满午后温暖阳光的花园草坪上嬉戏的小狗。其中一只是毛发蓬松的金色金毛幼犬，它快乐地伸着舌头，湿润的眼睛闪烁着兴奋的光芒；另一只是身手敏捷的杰克罗素梗，它以白色为主的短毛上点缀着棕色斑块，正顽皮地弓起身子准备扑向同伴。在慢镜头下，金毛幼犬率先发起一个笨拙而欢快的翻滚，在翠绿的草地上侧身倒下，四脚朝天，而杰克罗素梗则轻盈地一跃，从它身上跳过，它们的每一个动作都搅动起被阳光照得透亮的细碎草叶和几片飞舞的蒲公英种子。阳光穿透它们蓬松的皮毛，为它们的身体勾勒出一圈闪亮的金色轮廓，并在草地上投下柔和的长影。背景中，色彩斑斓的月季花丛和紫色的薰衣草在浅景深效果下虚化成一片柔美的色块，整个画面充满了温暖的色调，完美捕捉并放大了它们之间纯真、无忧无虑的互动，营造出一种极致宁静而又充满活力的幸福氛围。
prompt: slow-motion shot, filmed from a low angle, pans slowly to the right, tracking two puppies frolicking on a garden lawn bathed in the warm afternoon sun. One is a fluffy golden retriever, its tongue lolling out joyfully, its moist eyes sparkling with excitement. The other, an agile Jack Russell terrier, its short, predominantly white coat speckled with brown, playfully arches its back, poised to pounce on its companion. In slow motion, the golden retriever initiates a clumsy yet joyful roll, falling sideways on the emerald green grass, its legs in the air. The Jack Russell terrier leaps gracefully over it, their every movement stirring up the fine, sun-lit blades of grass and a few fluttering dandelion seeds. The sunlight filters through their fluffy fur, framing their bodies in a shimmering golden hue and casting long, soft shadows across the grass. In the background, the colorful rose bushes and purple lavender are blurred into a soft block of color due to the shallow depth of field effect. The entire picture is filled with warm tones, perfectly capturing and amplifying the innocent and carefree interaction between them, creating an extremely peaceful and vibrant atmosphere of happiness.

prompt_cn: 一个缓慢向下追踪的中景特写镜头，捕捉着一个古色古香的青瓷茶壶，它正以一种稳定而从容的姿态，在深不见底的漆黑水中缓缓下潜。这个茶壶拥有圆润的壶身和弯曲的壶嘴，表面布满了细腻的冰裂纹，在微光下显露出温润的质感。一连串晶莹剔透的微小气泡优雅地、持续地从壶嘴中逸出，盘旋着向上方升去，与茶壶的下沉轨迹形成鲜明对比。唯一的光源来自遥远的水面，那束逐渐变得微弱的光柱穿透黑暗，在壶身上投下柔和的高光，并照亮了那些转瞬即逝的气泡，而周围的水域则是一片纯粹的、深邃的黑暗，只有微小的悬浮颗粒在光路中若隐若现。随着茶壶越潜越深，水面上的光亮变得愈发遥远，整个画面被一种宁静、神秘且略带忧郁的诗意氛围所笼罩。
prompt: slow, tracking, medium close-up captures an antique celadon teapot, steadily and calmly descending into the inky blackness of the water. The teapot, with its rounded body and curved spout, is covered in delicate ice cracks, revealing a warm texture in the dim light. A stream of tiny, crystal-clear bubbles gracefully and continuously escapes from the spout, spiraling upwards and forming a striking contrast with the teapot's downward trajectory. The only source of light comes from the distant surface, a gradually fading beam of light piercing the darkness, casting soft highlights on the teapot and illuminating the fleeting bubbles. The surrounding water is a pure, profound darkness, with only tiny suspended particles glimpsed in the light's path. As the teapot sinks deeper, the light on the surface becomes increasingly distant, casting a tranquil, mysterious, and slightly melancholic poetic atmosphere.

prompt_cn: 一个动态追踪的特写镜头，紧紧锁定在一架线条硬朗、充满未来科技感的昆式战机驾驶舱上，其多边形切割的深灰色哑光复合材料机身在高速移动中反射着冷峻的光泽，机体接缝处流淌着明亮的蓝色能量脉冲灯带。战机正以雷霆万钧之势垂直下潜，机身周围的空气因极致的速度而产生肉眼可见的扭曲，下方是因风暴而波涛汹涌的深蓝色海洋，巨浪翻滚，掀起白色的泡沫。在接触水面的瞬间，战机前端毫不费力地破开翻涌的海浪，激起一道由无数晶莹水珠和白色泡沫构成的、爆炸般的环形巨浪向四周猛烈扩散。在戏剧性的光影下，几缕穿透厚重乌云的冷峻日光，在高光下勾勒出战机湿润的金属光泽，飞溅的水花与机身上闪烁的蓝色能量脉冲灯带交相辉映，战机随即在巨大的漩涡中消失于水下，整个过程充满了漫威电影般宏大而富有冲击力的视觉风格，营造出一种极致的力量感与高科技的冷酷美学。
prompt: dynamic tracking close-up focuses on the cockpit of a Quinjet, a sleek, futuristic-looking aircraft. Its polygonally cut, matte-gray composite fuselage reflects a cool sheen at high speed, while bright blue energy-pulsing light strips flow through the seams. The aircraft plummets with thunderous force, the air around it visibly distorting at its breakneck speed. Below, a storm-rippled deep blue ocean churns, its waves rolling and stirring up white foam. Upon contact, the front of the aircraft effortlessly breaks through the surging waves, unleashing a massive, circular wave of countless shimmering water droplets and white foam that spreads violently in all directions. Under the dramatic light and shadow, a few rays of cold sunlight penetrated the thick dark clouds, outlining the moist metallic luster of the fighter plane in the high light. The splashing water and the flashing blue energy pulse light strips on the fuselage complemented each other. The fighter plane then disappeared underwater in a huge whirlpool. The whole process was full of the grand and impactful visual style of Marvel movies, creating an ultimate sense of power and high-tech cool aesthetics.

prompt_cn: 以逼真的CGI纪录片现实主义风格，动态跟踪镜头跟随未来派无人机进行稳定而深思熟虑的垂直爬升。相机完美同步上升，保持无人机的中等镜头，该无人机采用光滑的空气动力学机身，由哑光白色复合材料和抛光深色碳纤维制成。微妙的蓝色LED灯从其旋转臂上发出，表明其处于活动状态。无人机毫不费力地爬上一座陡峭、阳光普照的赭色砂岩悬崖，其粗糙、饱经风霜的纹理引人注目。随着无人机上升高度，低沉的金色太阳从下面延伸的广阔峡谷中的每一个岩石露头上投射出长长的、锋利的阴影，创造出一幅戏剧性而令人惊叹的风景，其中充满温暖的亮点和深邃的冷色调的空洞。无人机的螺旋桨进行微小、精确的调整，以保持其完美的上升，其中央万向节安装的摄像机镜头保持完美稳定，体现了一种安静的技术力量感，对抗自然世界的巨大原始之美，唤起了一种强大的敬畏和发现氛围。
prompt: In the style of photorealistic CGI documentary realism, a dynamic tracking shot follows a futuristic drone as it makes a steady and deliberate vertical climb. The camera rises in perfect sync, maintaining a medium shot of the drone, which features a sleek, aerodynamic body constructed from matte white composite and polished dark carbon fiber. Subtle blue LED lights emanate from its rotating arm, indicating its active state. The drone effortlessly scales a sheer, sun-drenched ochre sandstone cliff, its rough, weathered texture striking. As the drone gains altitude, the low, golden sun casts long, sharp shadows across every rock outcrop in the vast canyon stretching below, creating a dramatic and breathtaking landscape filled with warm highlights and deep, cool-toned voids. The drone's propellers make minute, precise adjustments to maintain its perfect ascent, while its central gimbal-mounted camera lens remains perfectly steady, embodying a sense of quiet technological power against the immense, raw beauty of the natural world, evoking a powerful atmosphere of awe and discovery.

prompt_cn: 一个从高角度俯瞰的静态广角镜头，将我们带入一个完全由复古像素画构成的世界。一张巨大的、由粗大发光的蓝色像素线条构成的复杂电网结构图，悬浮在一片由深紫色和黑色块构成的广阔城市剪影之上。在这张数字化的地图上，代表着核心能量枢纽的大型方形像素集群，正以一种稳定而催眠的节奏，有规律地闪烁着明亮的青色光芒，每一次脉动都短暂地照亮了周围的网格。随着枢纽的闪烁，一股股由纯白色发光像素粒子组成的能量流，如同数字化的河流，迅速而无声地沿着预设的网格线路，在城市上空穿梭，连接着不同的枢纽。这些流动的光束在下方黑暗的、由像素构成的锯齿状建筑轮廓上投下了锐利且不断移动的块状阴影，光影在复杂的城市几何体上交织、追逐，创造出一种动态的、充满科技感的视觉韵律，整个画面沉浸在一种冷色调的数字氛围中，充满了系统性的美感和一种冷静、高效的能量流动感。
prompt: static, wide-angle shot, shot from a high vantage point, transports us into a world composed entirely of retro pixel art. A vast, complex grid structure, composed of thick, glowing blue pixels, hovers above a vast city silhouette composed of deep purple and black blocks. On this digital map, large clusters of square pixels, representing core energy hubs, pulse with a steady, hypnotic rhythm, flashing a brilliant cyan light. Each pulse briefly illuminates the surrounding grid. As these hubs flicker, streams of pure white, glowing pixel particles, like digital rivers, swiftly and silently weave across the city, connecting the various hubs along pre-defined grid lines. These flowing beams cast sharp, shifting, blocky shadows on the dark, jagged, pixelated building outlines below. Light and shadow intertwine and chase across the complex urban geometry, creating a dynamic, technologically charged visual rhythm. The entire image is immersed in a cool, digital atmosphere, imbued with a systematic beauty and a sense of calm, efficient energy flow.

prompt_cn: 高速视角跟踪镜头推动观众沿着巨大的仓库的中央过道无情地前进。两侧两侧是由灰色镀锌钢建造的高耸工业货架，向上延伸到光线昏暗的高天花板上，那里几乎看不到钢桁架。这些货架上密集地摆满了各种各样的商品--各种尺寸的纸板箱、收缩包装的托盘和彩色产品容器--这些商品演变成无缝的、由泥土般的棕色、白色和转瞬即逝的原色组成的、运动模糊的条纹，相机飞驰而过。抛光的混凝土地板上标有褪色的黄色中心线，反射出头顶荧光灯带发出的有节奏的冷白色强光，创造出催眠的频闪效果，凸显了令人难以置信的速度。构图完全对称，架子和地板的平行线汇聚在远处朦胧的消失点上，创造出强大的深度感和无尽的规模。气氛是机械精确性和压倒性的后勤规模，让观众沉浸在纯粹、令人兴奋的前进动力的感觉中。
prompt: high-speed POV tracking shot propels the viewer relentlessly along the central aisle of a vast warehouse. Flanked on either side by towering industrial shelves constructed of gray galvanized steel, they rise to a dimly lit, high ceiling, where the steel trusses are barely perceptible. These shelves are densely packed with a vast array of merchandise—cardboard boxes of varying sizes, shrink-wrapped pallets, and colorful product containers—which evolve into a seamless, motion-blurred streak of earthy browns, whites, and fleeting primary colors as the camera darts past. The polished concrete floor, marked with a faded yellow centerline, reflects the rhythmic, cool white glare of overhead fluorescent strips, creating a hypnotic strobe effect that underscores the incredible speed. The composition is perfectly symmetrical, with the parallel lines of shelves and floor converging on a hazy vanishing point in the distance, creating a powerful sense of depth and endless scale. The atmosphere is one of mechanical precision and overwhelming logistical scale, immersing the viewer in a feeling of pure, exhilarating forward momentum.

prompt_cn: 以令人惊叹的超高速摄影风格拍摄的极端特写镜头保持完美静态，以定格一个奇异、暴力的时刻。画面左侧的单一戏剧性光源将主体从纯黑色背景中雕刻出来，创造出强烈的对比度和深深的阴影。在构图的中心，半透明、形状不规则的冰雹瞬间与亮黄色、扇形的银杏叶相撞。这种撞击在微观上被清晰地捕捉到：冰雹爆炸成壮观的飞溅，发出由水晶冰碎片和闪闪发光的完美球形水滴组成的王冠状日冕向外飞行。强大的侧面照明捕捉到每一个碎片和液滴的边缘，使它们在虚空中像钻石一样闪闪发光。与此同时，叶子精致的蜡质表面在力的作用下明显变形，在撞击点有一个明显的凹陷，同心的高频波纹从那里发出，扭曲了其原本光滑的纹理，并强调了其复杂的纹理结构。场景的气氛是一种激烈的、悬浮的戏剧，将自然的原始力量与近乎科学的、贫瘠的美丽融为一体。
prompt: Shot in a breathtaking ultra-high-speed style, extreme close-ups remain perfectly static, capturing a bizarre, violent moment. A single dramatic light source on the left side of the frame carves the subject out of the stark black background, creating intense contrast and deep shadows. At the center of the composition, translucent, irregularly shaped hailstones momentarily collide with a bright yellow, fan-shaped ginkgo leaf. This impact is captured with microscopic clarity: the hailstone explodes in a spectacular splash, sending a crown-like corona of crystal ice shards and sparkling, perfectly spherical droplets flying outward. Powerful side lighting captures the edges of each fragment and droplet, making them glitter like diamonds against the void. Meanwhile, the leaf's delicate, waxy surface is visibly deformed by the force of the impact, with a noticeable indentation at the point of impact, from which concentric, high-frequency ripples emanate, distorting its otherwise smooth texture and emphasizing its intricate grain structure. The atmosphere of the scene is one of intense, suspended drama, blending the raw power of nature with an almost scientific, barren beauty.

prompt_cn: 该相机以高速摄影令人惊叹的清晰度捕捉到，在起飞的精确时刻，以超慢动作绕着雄伟的白色起重机执行平稳的360度轨道运行。场景从鹤开始，它完美的白色羽毛被描绘成精致的细节，从一棵多节的古老松树上的栖息地吓了一跳，松树的深色、有裂缝的树皮充满了水分。当它的强大翅膀上长着黑色初级羽毛，果断地向下拍打时，一缕闪闪发光的晨露从松针上喷出。每一滴单独的水滴都悬浮在空气中，像一颗微小的、多面的宝石一样在时间中凝固，捕捉并折射升起的太阳温暖的金色光芒。在层层迷雾的山峰令人惊叹的背景下，绕轨道运行的摄像机捕捉到每根羽毛的错综复杂的纹理、强大的翅膀拱起，以及透过水滴散射的灿烂棱镜光，创造出一种宁静而令人惊叹的氛围，冻结了自然力量和精致之美的转瞬即逝的瞬间。
prompt: Capturing the precise moment of takeoff with the breathtaking clarity of high-speed photography, the camera executes a smooth 360-degree orbit in ultra-slow motion around the majestic white crane. The scene begins with the crane, its perfect white feathers depicted in exquisite detail, startled from its perch atop a gnarled, ancient pine tree, its dark, cracked bark brimming with moisture. As its powerful wings, studded with black primary feathers, flap decisively downward, a wisp of glistening morning dew erupts from the pine needles. Each individual water droplet, suspended in the air, frozen in time like a tiny, multi-faceted gem, captures and refracts the warm golden light of the rising sun. Against the breathtaking backdrop of misty peaks, the orbiting camera captures the intricate texture of each feather, the powerful arch of its wings, and the brilliant prismatic light scattered through the water droplets, creating a serene and awe-inspiring atmosphere that freezes a fleeting moment of nature's power and exquisite beauty.

prompt_cn: 一个静态的、与眼睛齐平的中等特写镜头聚焦在一个人以平稳、深思熟虑的步态行走时，一个豪华的皮革钱包有节奏地从一个人的肩膀上摆动。这款钱包由浓郁的深巧克力棕色小牛皮制成，纹理微妙，具有结构化的马鞍袋轮廓，边缘有细致的奶油色缝线。它挂在穿着厚实、柔软的象牙白羊绒衫的人的肩膀上，针织品的精致质感与光滑的皮革形成鲜明对比。当钱包以柔和、催眠的弧线来回晃动时，其抛光的长方形金色扣捕捉到优雅房间柔和而漫无目的的头顶灯光，每次动作都会产生短暂的明星般的闪光。背景是抛光的深色硬木地板和高大的极简主义灰白色墙壁的浅焦模糊，暗示着一家高端精品店或艺术画廊。场景沐浴在温暖、温柔的灯光下，营造出一种安静精致、低调奢华和宁静动感的氛围。
prompt: static, eye-level medium close-up focuses on a luxurious leather wallet rhythmically swinging from a person's shoulder as they walk with a steady, deliberate gait. Crafted from rich, dark chocolate brown calfskin with a subtle grain, the wallet features a structured saddlebag silhouette and delicate cream stitching along the edges. It hangs from the shoulder of a person wearing a thick, soft ivory cashmere sweater, the delicate texture of the knit contrasting with the smooth leather. As the wallet swings back and forth in gentle, hypnotic arcs, its polished, rectangular gold buckle captures the soft, unfocused overhead lighting of the elegant room, creating a fleeting, star-like flash with each movement. The background, a light-focus blur of polished dark hardwood floors and tall, minimalist off-white walls, suggests a high-end boutique or art gallery. The scene is bathed in warm, gentle light, creating an atmosphere of quiet refinement, understated luxury, and serene movement.

prompt_cn: 一个略微仰拍的中景镜头，镜头缓慢地向左平移，扫过一座金碧辉煌、充满盛唐气派的宏伟宫殿内部。高大的朱红色立柱上盘绕着鎏金龙雕，天花板上繁复的彩绘藻井在悬挂的巨大宫灯和成排青铜烛台的摇曳烛光下投下跳跃的阴影。几位神秘人物身着深红色飞鱼服，衣服上用金线精心绣制的飞鱼纹样在火光下闪烁着危险的光芒，他们头戴宽檐笠帽，帽檐下的脸庞隐没在阴影中，只露出坚毅的下颌线条。腰间悬挂的绣春刀，其黑漆刀鞘与黄铜配饰显得格外醒目。其中一人正以一种冷酷而高效的姿态，从腰间的布袋中取出一个简陋的食物，稳定而从容地将其丢在一名被粗绳捆绑、跪在地上的俘虏面前。这些俘虏衣衫褴褛，与周围的华丽环境形成鲜明对比，脸上交织着恐惧与麻木。整个分发过程精准而机械，没有任何言语交流，只有丝绸衣物的摩擦声和物品落在光洁如镜的黑色石质地板上的轻微闷响，在空旷的大殿中回荡，营造出一种庄严肃穆却又令人窒息的紧张氛围。
prompt: medium shot, taken slightly from above, slowly pans leftward across the interior of a magnificent palace, shimmering with golden splendor and imbued with the grandeur of the Tang Dynasty. Tall vermilion pillars are entwined with gilded dragon carvings. The intricately painted ceiling, adorned with caisson ceilings, casts dancing shadows under the flickering light of giant lanterns and rows of bronze candlesticks. Several mysterious figures, dressed in crimson flying fish robes, their intricately embroidered flying fish patterns gleaming menacingly in the firelight. Their faces, hidden beneath wide-brimmed hats, are shrouded in shadow, revealing only their resolute jawlines. Embroidered spring swords, dangling from their waists, their black lacquer scabbards and brass fittings stand out. With a cold and efficient gesture, one of the figures removes a simple food item from a cloth pouch and drops it steadily and calmly before a captive, bound with thick ropes and kneeling on the ground. The captives' tattered clothing contrasts sharply with the opulence of their surroundings, their faces a mixture of fear and numbness. The entire distribution process was precise and mechanical, without any verbal communication. Only the friction of silk clothing and the slight muffled sound of items falling on the mirror-like black stone floor echoed in the empty hall, creating a solemn yet suffocating atmosphere of tension.

prompt_cn: 一张宏观、严密的追踪镜头平稳地跟随着一群彩虹色玻璃鲶鱼，它们的动作以客观且信息丰富的风格捕捉，让人想起高清自然纪录片。摄像机横向滑动，保持恒定距离，鱼以完美、闪闪发光的一致性移动穿过茂密的水下充满活力的绿色水生植物树林。它们完全透明的身体就像活镜头，让明亮、均匀的光线从上面穿过，并明亮地照亮它们精致的银色隆突--每一根椎骨和肋骨都清晰可见。当它们进行协调一致的群体觅食动作时，它们长长的、丝线状的倒刺不断而细致地抽搐，感知悬浮在晶莹剔透的水中的微小食物颗粒。光线从不同的角度捕捉到他们的皮肤，在郁郁葱葱的树叶背景下创造出微妙的、柔和的粉红色、蓝色和绿色的变化彩虹色。整个场景呈现出超现实的细节，创造了一个宁静和迷人的气氛，专注于这种自然行为的安静，复杂的美丽。
prompt: macro, tight tracking shot smoothly follows a school of iridescent glass catfish, their movements captured with an objective and informative style reminiscent of a high-definition nature documentary. The camera pans sideways, maintaining a constant distance, as the fish move with perfect, shimmering unity through a dense forest of vibrant green underwater aquatic plants. Their completely transparent bodies act like living lenses, allowing bright, even light to filter through and brilliantly illuminate their delicate silver protuberances—every vertebra and rib is clearly visible. As they engage in coordinated group feeding movements, their long, silky barbs twitch constantly and delicately, sensing tiny food particles suspended in the crystal-clear water. Light catches their skin from varying angles, creating a subtle, soft iridescence of pinks, blues, and greens against a backdrop of lush foliage. The entire scene is rendered in surreal detail, creating a tranquil and captivating atmosphere focused on the quiet, complex beauty of this natural behavior.

prompt_cn: 电影般的微距特写镜头，用静态相机以稍微高角度定位，在一个鲜明的、无反射的黑色空洞中捕捉场景。三股不同的粘稠、高光液体开始流入画框：一股是深红色的动脉色;另一股是明亮的纯白;第三股是浓郁的深海军蓝。它们以一种令人着迷的慢动作优雅移动，像厚厚的瓷漆一样旋转和纠缠。液体优雅地相互交织，红色和白色的溪流形成平行的起伏丝带。与此同时，海军蓝色液体在左上角汇集成一个完美的矩形。当液体开始凝结时，它们的流体运动稳步减速，在蓝色场中，白色液体精心地形成了五十颗微小的、尖锐的恒星。整个构图逐渐凝固，凝固成一面飘扬的美国国旗的动态三维形状，在看不见的微风中，其表面保留着微妙的液体般的光泽。戏剧性的侧面灯光在旗帜的褶皱中投射出深深的阴影，凸显了丰富的纹理，并使充满活力的色彩在绝对的黑暗中流行起来，营造出一种雄伟而神奇的创作氛围。
prompt: cinematic macro close-up, captured with a static camera positioned at a slightly high angle, captures the scene within a stark, non-reflective black void. Three distinct streams of viscous, glossy liquid begin to flow into the frame: one a deep, arterial red; another a brilliant, pure white; and the third a rich, deep navy blue. They gracefully move in mesmerizing slow motion, swirling and tangling like thick enamel. The liquids gracefully intertwine, with the red and white streams forming parallel, undulating ribbons. Meanwhile, the navy blue liquid converges into a perfect rectangle in the upper left corner. As the liquids begin to solidify, their fluid motion steadily decelerates, and within the blue field, the white liquid meticulously forms fifty tiny, pointed stars. The entire composition gradually solidifies, solidifying into the dynamic, three-dimensional form of a fluttering American flag, its surface retaining a subtle, liquid-like sheen in the invisible breeze. Dramatic side lighting casts deep shadows within the flag's folds, highlighting its rich textures and making its vibrant colors pop against the absolute darkness, creating a majestic and magical atmosphere.

prompt_cn: 一个从平视角度拍摄的特写静态镜头，画面聚焦于一面略带粗糙质感的白色墙壁，它成为了光影的画布。明亮而温暖的午后阳光穿过画面外的竹林，将细长的竹叶和交错竹竿的影子投射其上，形成一幅斑驳的光影图案。随着微风的轻拂，这些轮廓柔和、深浅不一的灰色影子仿佛被赋予了生命，在墙面上缓慢而有节奏地摇曳、涌动，时而舒展，时而重叠，光影的边缘在流动中不断变化，创造出一种动态的、仿佛在呼吸的视觉效果。整个画面呈现出一种极致的宁静与诗意，主色调为纯净的白色与丰富的灰色层次，暖色调的光线为这幅无声的动态画卷注入了悠闲与平和的禅意氛围。
prompt: close-up, static shot captured from a level angle focuses on a slightly rough-textured white wall, a canvas for light and shadow. Bright, warm afternoon sunlight filters through the bamboo forest beyond the frame, casting shadows of slender leaves and intertwined bamboo stalks, creating a dappled pattern of light and shadow. Gentle breezes bring these softly contoured, varying shades of gray to life, slowly and rhythmically swaying and flowing across the wall, sometimes stretching, sometimes overlapping, the edges of light and shadow constantly shifting in this fluid movement, creating a dynamic, almost breathing visual effect. The entire image exudes a sense of profound tranquility and poetry, dominated by a palette of pure white and rich shades of gray. The warm tones of light imbue this silent, dynamic painting with a sense of leisure and peaceful Zen.

prompt_cn: 低角度、静态中等镜头捕捉到了黄色反铲臂用力扎入地面时的巨大力量。重型钢臂涂有轻微风化的工业黄色油漆，并显示出磨损迹象，带有油斑和轻微划痕，具有机械精度。它的带齿金属桶深深地咬入泥土，通过故意而有力的卷曲，它舀起了一大堆肥沃的深色土壤，其中混合着各种大小的锯齿状灰色岩石。整个场景都被正午阳光的刺眼直射光照亮，广阔、无云、灿烂的蓝天下。这种明亮的光线会产生尖锐、明确的阴影，并在手臂的金属表面和出土石头的闪闪发光的小平面上产生灿烂的闪光。当手臂开始稳定地向上抬起，在重量下稍微拉紧时，大气层是集中的、原始的工业力量，展示了机器对自然景观的蛮力。
prompt: low-angle, static medium shot captures the immense force of a yellow backhoe arm as it drives into the ground. Painted in a lightly weathered industrial yellow paint, the heavy steel arm shows signs of wear, with oil stains and light scratches, yet possesses a mechanical precision. Its toothed metal bucket bites deeply into the earth, and with a deliberate, powerful curl, it scoops up a vast mound of rich, dark soil, intermixed with jagged gray rocks of various sizes. The entire scene is illuminated by the harsh, direct light of the midday sun, set against a vast, cloudless, brilliant blue sky. This brilliant light creates sharp, well-defined shadows and brilliant glints on the arm's metal surface and the gleaming facets of unearthed stone. As the arm begins its steady upward lift, straining slightly under its weight, the atmosphere is one of concentrated, raw industrial power, showcasing the brute force of a machine over the natural landscape.

prompt_cn: 一张无缝、缓慢的360度旋转镜头，以与眼睛齐平的中等视角拍摄，绕着一座矗立在光线昏暗、废弃的厨房中的1950年代老式炉灶旋转。这个炉子，有着破碎的淡绿松石釉饰面和镀铬把手，开始经历超现实的腐烂。最初，炉灶的一角闪闪发光，随着釉质破裂和剥落，其固体形式摇摆不定，露出下面炽热的液体核心。铸铁结构稳定而故意地溶解，不是通过融化，而是通过转变为浓稠的银热液体，缓慢地从其两侧滴下。当摄像机继续其不慌不忙的圆形路径时，它揭示了更多的炉子屈服于这个过程，曾经坚硬的炉腿和烤箱门现在下垂并向下流动。这些熔融金属流聚集在黑白棋盘漆布地板上，形成一个不断扩大、闪闪发光的水坑，反映了上面不可能的转变。场景中唯一重要的光线来自熔化的金属本身，在尘土飞扬的台面和褪色的花卉壁纸上投射出温暖、闪烁的橙色光芒和深邃、舞蹈的阴影，创造出一种令人着迷但深感不安的安静、不可阻挡的瓦解氛围。
prompt: seamless, slow-moving 360-degree rotating shot, shot at a medium angle at eye level, revolves around a vintage 1950s stove standing in a dimly lit, abandoned kitchen. The stove, with its crumbling pale turquoise glaze and chrome handles, begins to undergo a surreal decay. Initially, a corner of the stove gleams, its solid form wavering as the glaze cracks and flakes, revealing a fiery, liquid core beneath. The cast iron structure steadily and deliberately dissolves, not by melting but by transforming into a thick, silvery, hot liquid that slowly drips down its sides. As the camera continues its unhurried, circular path, it reveals more of the stove succumbing to the process, its once-solid legs and oven door now sagging and flowing downward. These streams of molten metal gather on the black and white checkerboard linoleum floor, forming an ever-expanding, shimmering puddle that reflects the impossible transformation above. The only significant light in the scene comes from the molten metal itself, casting a warm, flickering orange glow and deep, dancing shadows across the dusty countertops and faded floral wallpaper, creating an atmosphere of quiet, inexorable disintegration that is both mesmerizing and deeply unsettling.

prompt_cn: 一个极致的特写镜头，从略带倾斜的侧面角度进行静态拍摄，将焦点完全集中在一滴晶莹剔透、形态完美的泪珠上。这滴泪珠正沿着一位年轻女性光洁白皙的脸颊，缓慢而沉重地向下滑落，其移动的轨迹在皮肤上留下一道微弱而湿润的痕迹。柔和温暖的自然光，仿佛来自午后窗边的漫射光，温柔地笼罩着整个画面，使得泪珠本身如同一颗微小的、会折射光线的液体宝石，而皮肤则呈现出一种细腻且富有弹性的质感。就在泪珠即将滑至下颌线之际，一根修长而干净的手指，带着一种几乎是虔诚的缓慢，温柔地进入画面。指尖以一种羽毛般轻柔的力度，小心翼翼地触碰到泪珠下方的皮肤，然后稳定而从容地向上轻轻一抹，精准地接住并拭去了那滴泪水，这个动作极其轻柔，几乎没有在皮肤上留下任何压力，只是将那道淡淡的湿痕温柔地晕开，整个场景的色调温暖而柔和，营造出一种极致的静谧、深切的安慰与无声的亲密感。
prompt: stunning close-up, captured from a slightly tilted side angle and statically, focuses squarely on a single, crystal-clear, perfectly formed teardrop. It slowly and heavily glides down the smooth, fair cheek of a young woman, leaving a faint, moist trail on her skin. Soft, warm natural light, as if diffused from a late afternoon window, gently envelops the frame, making the teardrop resemble a tiny, refracting liquid gem, while the skin appears delicate and resilient. Just as the teardrop is about to reach the jawline, a slender, clean finger, with an almost reverent slowness and gentleness, enters the frame. With feather-light force, the fingertips carefully touched the skin below the teardrop, then gently wiped it upwards steadily and calmly, accurately catching and wiping away the tear. The action was extremely gentle, leaving almost no pressure on the skin, just gently blurring the faint wet mark. The tones of the whole scene were warm and soft, creating a sense of ultimate tranquility, deep comfort and silent intimacy.

prompt_cn: 一个缓慢向前推进的仰拍中景镜头，画面聚焦于一座幽深而古老的洞穴腹地。一名身着深色麻布长袍、长发用一根简单的布带束在脑后的侠客，正肃穆地站立在一面巨大的天然石壁前。他的面容坚毅，眼神中充满了敬畏与专注。一束天光从洞顶的狭窄裂隙中倾泻而下，恰好照亮了他和面前的壁画，空气中细微的尘埃在光柱中缓缓飘浮。石壁上，一条鳞甲斑驳、身躯盘踞的东方神龙壁画历经风霜，正处于沉睡之中，双目紧闭。侠客左手小心翼翼地托着一个古朴的陶碗，碗中盛着粘稠如血的朱砂。他深吸一口气，稳定而从容地伸出右手食指，庄重地探入碗中蘸取了那抹鲜艳的红色。随即，他抬起手臂，沾满朱砂的指尖仿佛一管蕴含着无上法力的神笔，在离龙首紧闭的右眼仅一寸处稍作停顿，然后果断而精准地向前一点。在指尖触碰冰冷石壁的瞬间，那点朱砂仿佛被注入了生命，散发出微弱而温暖的金色光芒，为沉睡千年的神龙赋予了灵魂，整个场景在昏暗与光明的强烈对比下，营造出一种神秘、庄严且充满强大力量即将被唤醒的史诗氛围。
prompt: slow, upward-sweeping medium shot zooms in, focusing on the depths of a deep, ancient cavern. A knight, clad in a dark linen robe, his long hair tied back with a simple cloth sash, stands solemnly before a massive natural stone wall. His face is resolute, his eyes filled with awe and concentration. A beam of sunlight pours through a narrow crack in the cave ceiling, illuminating him and the mural before him. Fine dust particles in the air drift slowly in the beam of light. On the stone wall, a mural depicting a scaly, coiled figure of an Eastern dragon, weathered by the wind, lies in deep sleep, its eyes closed. In his left hand, the knight carefully holds an ancient ceramic bowl filled with cinnabar, thick as blood. He takes a deep breath, then, steady and deliberate, extends his right index finger, solemnly dipping it into the bowl to scoop up the vibrant red. Then, he raised his arm, his cinnabar-soaked fingertips like a divine brush imbued with supreme power. He paused, a mere inch from the dragon's tightly closed right eye, then pointed forward decisively and precisely. The moment his fingertips touched the cold stone, the cinnabar seemed to be infused with life, emitting a faint yet warm golden glow, giving life to the thousand-year-slumbering dragon. The entire scene, with its stark contrast of darkness and light, created an atmosphere of mystery, solemnity, and an epic aura of a powerful force about to awaken.

prompt_cn: 一张超现实的CG镜头，从略高的角度拍摄了一个亲密的静态特写，捕捉到了一位年轻女子的深棕色头发扎成光滑的高马尾辫，她的表情非常专注。她的眉头微微皱起，目光专注地盯着缝纫机的针，双手小心翼翼地引导着一条充满活力的猩红色缎面布料，手指施加稳定、温和的压力以确保路径畅通。相机保持着锐利的焦点，聚焦于抛光的钢制脚垫和快速下降的针的机械芭蕾，它完美地缝合了一行相匹配的红线，清晰度令人惊叹。每个微动作，从线环到织物前进，都以逼真的精确度渲染。一束聚焦的暖光（可能来自刚离开画面的作业灯）照亮了直接的缝纫区域，在金属部件和光泽线上创造了明亮的亮点，同时投射出柔和的阴影。背景融化为美丽的散景，柔和的温暖、失焦色彩，暗示着创意工作室，创造出一种宁静而专注的氛围，颂扬工艺艺术。
prompt: hyper-realistic CG shot, captured from a slightly elevated angle in an intimate, static close-up, captures a young woman, her dark brown hair tied into a sleek, high ponytail, her expression intensely focused. Her brow furrowed slightly, her gaze fixed intently on the sewing machine's needle, her hands carefully guiding a strand of vibrant scarlet satin fabric, fingers applying steady, gentle pressure to ensure a clear path. The camera maintains sharp focus, zeroing in on the mechanical ballet of the polished steel foot and the rapidly descending needle as it perfectly stitches a line of matching red thread with breathtaking clarity. Every micro-movement, from the loop of thread to the advance of fabric, is rendered with realistic precision. A focused beam of warm light (perhaps from a task light that has just left the frame) illuminates the immediate sewing area, creating bright highlights on the metal components and glossy thread while casting soft shadows. The background melts into a beautiful bokeh, a soft, warm, out-of-focus color suggestive of a creative studio, creating a tranquil and focused atmosphere that celebrates the art of craftsmanship.

prompt_cn: 下午晚些时候晴朗的天空下，一个低角度跟踪镜头在地面上方快速滑行，穿过一片阳光普照的广阔麦田。黄金时刻低沉而温暖的光线将成熟、头重的茎沐浴在浓郁的琥珀色色调中，在风景上投下长长而柔和的阴影。突然，一股看不见的力量穿过磁场，其路径上有一股猛烈而混乱的波浪，直接在镜头前爆发。摄像机跟随这股看不见的尾流，撕裂了一条前进的道路，将脆弱的金色茎从干燥的土壤中撕下，并将它们向上抛入湍流的漩涡中。数千根单独的茎和细谷壳云被抛向空中，瞬间捕捉到阳光，就像一阵混乱、闪闪发光的五彩纸屑，然后开始混乱地落下来。这场运动不是一次温柔的离别，而是一次爆炸性的、强大的扰动，在风景的宁静之美与穿行其间的原始、看不见的力量之间形成鲜明对比，唤起了一种敬畏和神秘恐惧的强大氛围。
prompt: Under a clear late afternoon sky, a low-angle tracking shot glides swiftly above the ground across a vast, sun-drenched wheat field. The low, warm light of the golden hour bathes the ripe, top-heavy stalks in a rich amber hue, casting long, soft shadows across the landscape. Suddenly, an unseen force tears through the field, carrying a violent, chaotic wave in its path that erupts directly in front of the camera. The camera follows this invisible wake as it tears a path forward, tearing the fragile golden stalks from the dry soil and hurling them upward into a turbulent vortex. Thousands of individual stalks and clouds of fine chaff are tossed into the air, momentarily catching the sunlight like a chaotic, glittering shower of confetti, before beginning to fall chaotically. This movement is not a gentle departure but an explosive, powerful disturbance, creating a stark contrast between the tranquil beauty of the landscape and the raw, unseen forces surging through it, evoking a powerful atmosphere of awe and mysterious dread.

prompt_cn: 在一系列高速剪辑的动态镜头蒙太奇中，画面以一个聚焦于圣洁天使面部的极端特写开启，其双眼紧闭，雕塑般完美的脸庞上毫无瑕疵，银白色的长发在无形的能量场中微微浮动。镜头猛然切换为一个戏剧性的仰拍镜头，从天使身后捕捉到其光翼爆发性展开的瞬间，这对翅膀并非由羽毛构成，而是由纯粹、耀眼的金色光芒凝聚而成，无数光丝与粒子向外喷薄，瞬间照亮了周围由翻滚的紫色星云和深邃宇宙构成的黑暗背景。紧接着，一个快速的切镜对准了天使戴着华丽珍珠白金属护手的右手，它正紧紧握住一把古老长剑的剑柄，护手上的黄金圣纹在光芒下闪烁。随着一个流畅的弧形运镜，镜头跟随天使拔剑的动作，当燃烧着神圣火焰的利剑“噌”地一声出鞘时，剑身瞬间被熊熊燃烧的、无烟的白色烈焰所包裹。最终，镜头拉远为一个宏大的全景镜头，天使悬浮于宇宙虚空之中，巨大的光翼完全伸展，稳定而有力地扇动着，他单手高举燃烧的利剑，剑尖直指苍穹，其坚毅的表情和充满力量的姿态，在明亮的光芒与黑暗背景的强烈对比下，营造出一种神圣、威严且充满审判力量的史诗氛围。
prompt: series of high-speed, dynamic shots montages opens with an extreme close-up of the holy angel's face, its eyes closed, its sculpted features flawless and silvery-white hair gently swaying in an invisible field of energy. The camera suddenly cuts to a dramatic overhead shot, capturing from behind the angel the explosive unfurling of its wings. These wings are composed not of feathers but of pure, dazzling golden light. Countless filaments and particles of light burst forth, instantly illuminating the surrounding darkness of swirling purple nebulae and the abyss of space. Then, a rapid cut reveals the angel's right hand, adorned with an ornate pearl-white metal gauntlet. It grips the hilt of an ancient sword, its golden sacred emblems gleaming in the light. With a smooth, arcing movement, the camera follows the angel as he draws his sword. As the sacred, flame-burning sword unsheathes with a clang, the blade instantly engulfed in a blazing, smokeless white flame. Finally, the camera pulls out to a grand panoramic shot, in which the angel is suspended in the void of the universe, with his huge wings of light fully extended, flapping steadily and powerfully. He holds high the burning sword in one hand, with the tip pointing directly to the sky. His resolute expression and powerful posture, against the sharp contrast of the bright light and the dark background, create an epic atmosphere that is sacred, majestic and full of judgment power.

prompt_cn: 一个缓慢拉近的微仰拍远景镜头，将我们带入一片原始丛林的深处，一名探险家正孤身站立在一座宏伟的古老石门前。他身穿一件饱经风霜的卡其色多口袋夹克，衣角和袖口沾染着泥土的痕迹，内搭一件深灰色T恤，下身是耐磨的深色工装裤和一双布满泥泞的登山靴，整个人显得坚毅而略带疲惫。他面前的石门巨大而庄严，由整块深色岩石雕凿而成，表面布满了被岁月侵蚀的复杂浮雕，粗壮的深绿色藤蔓如巨蟒般盘绕其上，几乎要将它与周围的密林融为一体。在弥漫着潮湿雾气的空气中，这名探险家带着一丝犹豫但又充满决心地缓缓抬起右手，紧握成拳，在即将敲击那冰冷、长满青苔的石面之前，他的拳头在空中停顿了片刻。斑驳的日光穿透头顶茂密的树冠，投下道道光柱，照亮了空气中浮动的微尘，整个画面以深绿和大地色系为主调，营造出一种神秘、肃穆且充满悬念的氛围，仿佛一个尘封已久的秘密即将被揭开。
prompt: slow, upward-and-slightly-closed shot takes us deep into a pristine jungle, where a lone explorer stands before a majestic ancient stone gate. He wears a weathered, multi-pocket khaki jacket, its cuffs and hem stained with dirt, a dark gray T-shirt, durable dark overalls, and muddy hiking boots. He appears determined yet slightly exhausted. The gate before him is massive and majestic, carved from a single block of dark rock. Its surface is covered with intricate relief carvings eroded by time. Thick, dark green vines coil around it like giant pythons, almost blending it into the surrounding forest. In the damp, misty air, the explorer, hesitant yet resolute, slowly raises his right hand, clenching it into a fist. Before striking the cold, mossy stone, his fist pauses in mid-air. Dappled sunlight penetrates the dense treetops overhead, casting beams of light and illuminating the dust particles floating in the air. The entire picture is dominated by dark green and earth tones, creating a mysterious, solemn and suspenseful atmosphere, as if a long-buried secret is about to be revealed.

prompt_cn: 从超现实的第一人称视角来看，相机位于地面较低的位置，捕捉到了严酷、无云的蓝天下广阔、干旱的岩石平原的巨大规模。场景以一场深深的、令人心碎的震动开始，相机剧烈摇晃，导致整个景观振动，蜘蛛网裂缝立即穿过尘土飞扬的赭色地面。在没有任何警告的情况下，地平线本身开始弯曲，因为两个巨大的大陆板块以难以想象的力量碰撞，平坦的平原以缓慢但可怕的力量向上塌陷，将巨大的沉积岩板推向天空。相机伴随着这场灾难性的隆起，随着其下方的地面转变为新生山脉的陡峭、不稳定的表面，相机混乱地倾斜。照片般逼真的细节捕捉到了岩石在巨大规模上的研磨和剪切;数十亿吨的岩石呻吟和破碎，将厚厚的棕色尘埃送入大气层。锯齿状，锋利的山峰撕裂地壳，在明亮的阳光下投射出长长的阴影，创造了一种纯粹的，可怕的敬畏气氛，因为山脉在观众的眼前实时诞生。
prompt: Told from a surreal first-person perspective, the camera lies low to the ground, capturing the immense scale of the vast, arid rocky plain beneath a harsh, cloudless blue sky. The scene begins with a deep, heartbreaking tremor, the camera shaking violently, causing the entire landscape to vibrate and spiderweb-like cracks to instantly pierce the dusty ochre ground. Without warning, the horizon itself begins to buckle as two massive continental plates collide with unimaginable force, the flat plains collapsing upward with slow but terrifying force, thrusting vast slabs of sedimentary rock skyward. The camera accompanies this catastrophic uplift, tilting chaotically as the ground beneath it transforms into the steep, unstable surface of a new mountain range. Photorealistic detail captures the grinding and shearing of rock on a monumental scale; billions of tons of rock groan and shatter, sending thick clouds of brown dust into the atmosphere. Jagged, sharp peaks tear through the Earth's crust, casting long shadows in the bright sunlight, creating an atmosphere of pure, terrifying awe as the mountains are born in real time before the viewer's eyes.

prompt_cn: 一个从低角度仰拍的镜头，缓慢而稳定地向上倾斜并向前推进，引领观众深入一片古老而静谧的森林深处。在透过茂密树冠洒下的斑驳暮光中，成千上万个散发着内在光芒的半透明水晶碎片，如同有生命的萤火虫一般，从树木的缝隙和铺满厚厚落叶的地面缓缓升起。这些碎片呈现出温暖的金色、柔和的粉色和淡雅的蓝色，它们在空中划出优雅的轨迹，被一股无形的引力牵引着，螺旋式地向林间空地的中心汇聚。随着碎片的不断融入，一朵由纯粹光能构成的巨大水晶莲花，从一个微小的光核开始，稳定而从容地绽放开来。每一片半透明的花瓣都由无数微小的光点编织而成，显现出精致的纹理和脉络，而花蕊中心则散发出最为明亮、温暖的金色光芒。整个画面充满了宫崎骏动画标志性的温暖手绘感，色彩饱和而柔和，轮廓线条带着细腻的笔触质感。这朵光之花散发出的柔和光芒，将周围布满青苔的古树和地面染上了一层梦幻般的光晕，营造出一种极致宁静、神奇且充满治愈力量的氛围。
prompt: low-angle shot, slowly and steadily tilting upward and panning forward, draws the viewer deep into an ancient and tranquil forest. In the dappled twilight filtering through the dense canopy, thousands of translucent crystal fragments, radiating an inner glow, slowly rise from the cracks in the trees and from the leaf-covered ground like living fireflies. These fragments, shimmering in shades of warm gold, soft pink, and delicate blue, trace graceful paths through the air, drawn by an invisible gravitational force, spiraling toward the center of the forest clearing. As the fragments merge, a vast crystal lotus composed of pure light energy steadily and gracefully unfolds from a tiny core. Each translucent petal is woven from countless tiny points of light, revealing delicate textures and veins, while the center of the pistil radiates the brightest, warmest golden light. The entire image is imbued with the warm, hand-painted quality that is signature to Hayao Miyazaki's animations, with saturated, soft colors and delicate, brushstroke-like outlines. The soft glow of this flower of light casts a dreamy halo on the surrounding moss-covered ancient trees and the ground, creating an atmosphere of extreme tranquility, magic, and healing power.

prompt_cn: 一个超现实的慢动作镜头开始于一个极端的低角度特写镜头，捕捉到一个可怕的鸟类生物的锯齿状，强大的喙，染色赭石和碎片像燧石，啄积极进入硬，破裂的地球。撞击，以精致，尖锐的细节呈现，发出一股细尘和破碎的粘土碎片在无声的水晶芭蕾舞中向外爆炸。当斧头般的喙缩回时，相机开始缓慢而故意地抬起，以平稳的起重机拍摄。这一动作揭示了这种生物的头部：一只带有锐利黄色虹膜的爬行动物眼睛在捕食性焦点上收缩，它粗糙、蓬松的斑驳棕色和灰灰色羽毛随着这一动作而起伏。摄像机继续上升，揭示了恐怖比克完整、令人敬畏的身材，它强大、有鳞的腿为狩猎做好了准备。镜头最终扩大到了刺眼的白色阳光下广阔而荒凉的景观--一片被太阳烧焦的平原，布满破碎的泥土，一直延伸到侵蚀的平原的朦胧地平线。每一个尘埃颗粒都悬浮在干燥的空气中，热量的微光在贫瘠的广阔土地上造成了微妙的扭曲，在一个残酷、无情的世界中建立了一种紧张而原始的生存氛围。
prompt: surreal slow-motion shot begins in an extreme low-angle close-up, capturing the jagged, powerful beak of a terrifying bird-like creature, stained ochre and shards like flint, pecking aggressively into hard, cracked earth. The impact, rendered in exquisite, sharp detail, sends a plume of fine dust and shattered clay fragments exploding outward in a silent, crystalline ballet. As the axe-like beak retracts, the camera slowly and deliberately lifts up, in a steady crane shot. This movement reveals the creature's head: a reptilian eye with a sharp yellow iris constricts in predatory focus, its rough, fluffy plumage of mottled brown and ash-gray undulating with the motion. The camera continues to rise, revealing the full, awe-inspiring form of Terrorbeak, its powerful, scaly legs poised for the hunt. The shot eventually widens to reveal a vast, desolate landscape bathed in a harsh white sunlight—a sun-scorched plain strewn with crumbling earth, stretching to the hazy horizon of the eroded plain. Every dust particle suspended in the dry air, the shimmer of heat creates subtle distortions across the barren expanse, establishing a tense and primal atmosphere of survival in a harsh, unforgiving world.

prompt_cn: 一个紧贴着地面的低角度跟拍镜头，捕捉到一个被丢弃的白色纸质外卖盒，如同一艘孤独的小船，在雨后城市街道的路缘边汇集成的水流中平稳地漂流。这个已经被水浸湿的盒子边缘变得柔软，底部部分浸没在浑浊的水中，但其巧妙的折叠结构使其依然保持着浮力。它被一股温和而持续的水流推动着，稳定而从容地向前航行，偶尔在遇到像落叶这样的小障碍物时会轻轻地旋转一下。湿漉漉的沥青路面像一面黑色的镜子，闪烁着远处街灯的暖黄色光晕和店铺霓虹招牌的蓝、红色倒影，这些斑斓的光影在流动的水面上被拉长、扭曲，为这趟微型航行铺就了一条流光溢彩的航道。整个画面呈现出一种雨后夜晚特有的宁静与诗意氛围，将一个寻常的废弃物变成了一场意外而美丽的视觉奇观。
prompt: low-angle, tracking shot, close to the ground, captures a discarded white paper takeout container, like a lone boat, drifting steadily in the current that gathers along the curb of a rainy city street. The waterlogged container, its edges softened and its bottom partially submerged in the murky water, maintains its buoyancy thanks to its ingenious folding structure. Propelled by a gentle, steady current, it sails forward steadily and calmly, occasionally giving a gentle spin when encountering small obstacles like fallen leaves. The wet asphalt, like a black mirror, shimmers with the warm yellow glow of distant streetlights and the blue and red reflections of neon store signs. These shimmering shadows are stretched and distorted by the flowing water, paving a dazzling path for this miniature voyage. The entire scene evokes the unique tranquility and poetry of a rainy night, transforming an ordinary discarded object into an unexpected and beautiful visual spectacle.

prompt_cn: 从一个略带仰角的侧面中景镜头开始，相机平稳而流畅地向后拉远，一艘色彩极其鲜艳的龙舟正破浪前行。船头是一个雕刻精细、栩栩如生的金色龙头，张开的巨口和炯炯有神的红眼睛显得威猛无比。鲜红色的狭长船身在明媚的阳光下泛着光泽，船体两侧描绘着细密的金色龙鳞图案，随着船身的起伏仿佛在水中游动。船上的数十名船员肌肉结实，身穿统一的白色无袖背心，他们表情专注而坚毅，汗水在古铜色的皮肤上闪闪发光。在船头鼓手的有力敲击下，所有船员以惊人的一致性俯身、划桨，手中的木桨整齐划一地插入波光粼粼的河水中，再猛地向后发力，激起一排排白色的水花。随着镜头稳定地后退，画面逐渐开阔，不仅完整地展现了龙舟如同一支离弦之箭在宽阔河面上奋力航行的全貌，更揭示出河岸两旁挤满了挥舞着彩旗、高声呐喊助威的人群，整个场景充满了紧张激烈的竞赛氛围和团结协作的力量感，色调温暖而充满活力。
prompt: The film begins with a slightly elevated, sideways medium shot, then smoothly and fluidly pulls back to reveal a vibrantly colored dragon boat cutting through the waves. Amidst the prow lies a meticulously carved, lifelike golden dragon head, its gaping maw and piercing red eyes imbued with a powerful presence. The narrow, bright red hull gleams in the bright sunlight, its sides intricately emblazoned with golden dragon scales, seemingly swimming in the water as it rises and falls. The dozens of crew members, muscular and uniformly dressed in white sleeveless vests, wear focused, resolute expressions, their bronzed skin glistening with sweat. Under the powerful thumping of the drummer at the bow, each crew member leans forward and paddles with remarkable unison, their oars plunging into the shimmering water in unison. Then, with a powerful thrust, they thrust backward, sending up waves of white spray. As the camera steadily moves backward, the picture gradually widens, not only fully showing the full picture of the dragon boat sailing hard on the wide river like an arrow, but also revealing that the river banks are crowded with people waving colorful flags and cheering loudly. The whole scene is full of a tense and fierce atmosphere of competition and a sense of power of unity and cooperation, and the colors are warm and energetic.

prompt_cn: 一个从微仰视角度拍摄的动态追踪镜头，流畅地向左平移，捕捉了两只大眼睛蚊子在一场有趣的空中追逐，整个场景以一种高品质、明快的动漫风格渲染。领头的那只蚊子，有着超大尺寸、闪闪发光的祖母绿宝石般的眼睛和一丝狡黠的表情，它正灵巧地完成一个俏皮的空中回旋；紧随其后的是它的同伴，同样拥有巨大的蓝宝石色眼睛和顽皮而坚定的神情，在急转弯时倾斜着圆滚滚的卡通化身体。它们精致的半透明翅膀快速扇动，在光线下闪烁着如同肥皂泡般的虹彩光泽，而它们纤细而分节的肢体则在空中划出优美的弧线。这场追逐发生在一个阳光普照的魔法花园深处，背景是巨大的、挂着晶莹露珠的三叶草叶片和色彩鲜艳的巨大野花，形成了柔和的散景效果。一束温暖的金色午后阳光从画面外射入，形成一道柔和而空灵的镜头光晕，以橙色和金色的色调扫过屏幕，不仅突出了它们飞行的轨迹，也为这个充满活力的高饱和度调色板增添了梦幻感，营造出一种轻松、奇幻且充满欢乐能量的氛围。
prompt: dynamic tracking shot, shot from a slightly upward angle, pans smoothly to the left, capturing a playful aerial chase between two large-eyed mosquitoes, rendered in a high-quality, vibrant anime style. The leading mosquito, with its oversized, gleaming emerald eyes and a hint of slyness, deftly executes a playful aerial maneuver. Following closely behind is its companion, also sporting enormous sapphire eyes and a playful yet determined expression, tilting its round, cartoonish body through a sharp turn. Their delicate, translucent wings flap rapidly, shimmering in the light with a soap-bubble-like iridescence, while their slender, segmented limbs trace graceful arcs through the air. The chase takes place deep within a sun-drenched enchanted garden, against a backdrop of giant, dew-drenched clover leaves and vibrantly colored giant wildflowers, creating a soft bokeh effect. A beam of warm golden afternoon sunlight streams in from just outside the frame, creating a soft, ethereal lens flare that sweeps across the screen in orange and gold hues, accentuating their flight path while adding a dreamlike quality to this vibrant, highly saturated color palette, creating an atmosphere of lightheartedness, wonder, and joyful energy.

prompt_cn: 一个极致的特写镜头，对准一支石墨铅笔的笔尖，它在带有粗糙纹理的画纸上移动，每一次摩擦都发出被清晰放大的、令人舒适的沙沙声。随着笔尖稳定而流畅地划过，画纸上逐渐浮现出一件被风吹得鼓胀的男士衬衫的轮廓，线条充满动感，精准地捕捉了织物在空气中舒展的张力。随即，镜头稍稍拉远，揭示出握笔的是一位年轻女子，她有着松散挽起的深色长发，几缕发丝垂在脸颊旁，神情高度专注。她停下笔，仿佛完成了某个阶段，然后缓缓地、若有所思地抬起眼眸。就在此刻，镜头开始一次平滑而连贯的向上倾斜，跟随她的视线，从她的脸庞和画板上移开，越过阳台的栏杆，最终定格在广阔的天际线上。在那里，傍晚天空中最后一片绚烂的火烧云正在肉眼可见地溶解、变淡，其炽热的橙红色调温柔地褪变成一片宁静深远的鸽灰色，落日的余晖为整个场景镀上了一层温暖而转瞬即逝的金色光晕，营造出一种沉静、内省且充满诗意的氛围。
prompt: stunning close-up captures the tip of a graphite pencil as it moves across the rough, textured paper, each scrape creating a comforting, amplified, rustling sound. As the pencil's steady, fluid strokes unfold, the outline of a wind-blown men's shirt gradually emerges. The lines are imbued with movement, capturing the fabric's tension as it stretches in the air. Then, the camera pulls back slightly to reveal a young woman holding the pencil. Her long, dark hair is loosely tied, a few strands falling by her cheek, and her expression is one of intense concentration. She pauses, as if completing a stage, and slowly, thoughtfully, raises her eyes. At this moment, the camera begins a smooth, continuous upward tilt, following her gaze, moving from her face and the drawing board, over the balcony railing, and finally settling on the vast skyline. There, the last brilliant fiery clouds in the evening sky are visibly dissolving and fading, their fiery orange-red hues gently fading into a tranquil and profound dove gray. The afterglow of the setting sun casts a warm and fleeting golden halo on the entire scene, creating a quiet, introspective and poetic atmosphere.

prompt_cn: 动态的低角度特写追踪镜头将自己粘在Acinonyx概念车的侧面，以掠夺性的流畅性跟踪其每一个动作。该车辆的底盘是光滑的生物力学设计的奇迹，融合了哑光黑色的碳纤维涂层和合成的肌肉状筋，在抛光的半透明外壳下似乎可以弯曲。薄薄的、充满活力的青色光面板沿着其空气动力学轮廓嵌入，发出稳定的电子嗡嗡声。当汽车在雨水充足的多层高速公路上迅速果断地变道时，轮胎上溅起了闪闪发光的细水花。完美黑色、镜面般的柏油反映了赛博朋克城市景观压倒性的视觉噪音，导致汽车发光的面板和抛光表面成为高耸、空灵的全息广告的画布，这些广告在巨大的摩天大楼之间闪烁和故障。整个场景都以《壳中鬼》动画的喜怒无常、高细节的美学进行渲染，其特点是电蓝色、深紫色和霓虹粉红色的酷调色板，与深邃潮湿的阴影相映衬，营造出一种忧郁的美丽氛围和压倒性的技术密度。
prompt: dynamic, low-angle, close-up tracking shot glues itself to the side of the Acinonyx concept car, following its every movement with predatory fluidity. The vehicle's chassis is a marvel of sleek biomechanical design, a fusion of matte black carbon fiber coating and synthetic, muscle-like tendons that appear to flex beneath a polished, translucent shell. Thin, vibrant cyan panels are embedded along its aerodynamic contours, emitting a steady electronic hum. As the car changes lanes swiftly and decisively on the rain-soaked, multi-story highway, tiny, shimmering sprays of water emanate from its tires. The perfectly black, mirror-like asphalt reflects the overwhelming visual noise of the cyberpunk cityscape, causing the car's glowing panels and polished surfaces to become the canvas for towering, ethereal holographic advertisements that flicker and glitch between massive skyscrapers. The entire scene is rendered in the moody, highly detailed aesthetic of Ghost in the Shell animation, characterized by a cool palette of electric blue, deep purple, and neon pink, set against deep, damp shadows, creating an atmosphere of melancholic beauty and overwhelming technological density.

prompt_cn: 一个从略微俯视角度拍摄的极致特写镜头，将观众的视线完全锁定在一锅猛烈沸腾的川式火锅之中。鲜红滚烫的牛油汤底表面覆盖着一层闪耀着诱人光泽的红油，无数巨大的气泡从锅底翻涌而上，在表面激烈地破裂，溅起细微的油花，释放出袅袅的白色蒸汽。几片刚刚下锅的、纹理清晰的鲜嫩肥牛卷在滚汤中舒展、翻滚，其边缘正迅速地由生肉的红色烫熟为灰白色；几片翠绿的青菜叶在热浪中微微打蔫，与金黄色的、吸饱了汤汁的豆泡和切片香菇一起，随着汤水的每一次剧烈涌动而不断地沉浮、碰撞，仿佛在进行一场热烈而混乱的舞蹈。来自上方的暖色灯光在油亮的汤面上投下明亮的高光，让整个画面呈现出一种温暖、浓郁且充满人间烟火气的氛围，营造出一种令人垂涎欲滴的、极具冲击力的感官体验。
prompt: dramatic close-up shot from a slightly overhead angle locks the viewer's gaze firmly on a cauldron of bubbling Sichuan hot pot. The vibrant, scalding broth is coated in a layer of shimmering, alluring red oil. Countless giant bubbles surge upward from the bottom, violently bursting on the surface, sending up tiny droplets of oil and releasing wisps of white steam. Freshly sliced, tender, tender beef rolls, freshly simmered in the broth, unfurl and tumble, their edges rapidly transforming from raw red to off-white. A few emerald green leaves, slightly wilting in the heat, join golden, saturated tofu and sliced shiitake mushrooms, bobbing and colliding with each surge of the broth, as if engaging in a passionate and chaotic dance. Warm lighting from above casts bright highlights on the glossy broth, imbuing the scene with a warm, rich, and earthy atmosphere, creating a mouth-watering and deeply impactful sensory experience.

prompt_cn: 在一个从床脚位置向上拍摄的静态低角度中景镜头中，一间昏暗的卧室里，仅有微弱的月光从一侧窗户的百叶窗缝隙中渗透进来，在墙壁和家具上投下几道锐利而苍白的光带。一名留着凌乱深棕色长发的年轻女子，猛地从床上坐起，这个动作迅猛而僵硬，仿佛被无形的线向上拉扯。她身穿一件因冷汗而略微湿透的浅灰色纯棉T恤，额头上布满细密的汗珠，双眼因极度恐惧而圆睁，瞳孔在黑暗中收缩。她的嘴唇微张，胸膛剧烈地起伏，正发出短促而沙哑的喘息声，每一次吸气都像是在拼命争夺空气，双手下意识地紧紧抓皱了身下凌乱的白色床单。整个高对比度的冷色调画面充满了惊魂未定的恐慌感，营造出一种噩梦初醒后，被孤寂与窒息般恐惧所笼罩的紧张氛围。
prompt: In a static, low-angle, medium shot shot upward from the foot of a bed, a dim bedroom is captured. Only faint moonlight filters through the gaps in the blinds on one side of the window, casting sharp, pale streaks of light on the walls and furniture. A young woman with long, tousled, dark brown hair suddenly sits up in bed, her movement swift and stiff, as if pulled upward by invisible strings. She wears a light gray cotton T-shirt, slightly damp with cold sweat. Her forehead is beaded with beads of sweat. Her eyes are wide with utter terror, her pupils constricted in the darkness. Her lips part, her chest heaving violently as she breathes in short, hoarse gasps. Each inhale feels like a desperate struggle for air, and her hands subconsciously clutch the tousled white sheets beneath her. The high-contrast, cold-toned image is imbued with a sense of dread and suspense, creating a tense atmosphere of waking from a nightmare, enveloped in loneliness and suffocating fear.

prompt_cn: 一个史诗般的远景镜头，采用微仰拍角度，并以几乎无法察觉的速度缓慢向前推进，深入一片被晨曦微光笼罩的水墨画般的连绵山峦。一头苍青色的东方巨龙如同一条蜿蜒的山脉，庞大的身躯层层叠叠地盘踞在险峻的群峰之巅，其鳞片在清冷的光线下闪烁着金属与玉石混合的冷硬光泽，山谷间流淌的乳白色云海仅能淹没其身躯的一半。巨龙的头颅原本低垂，峥嵘的龙角如同枯死的古树枝干，长长的龙须在山风中微微拂动，突然，它那覆盖着岩石般纹理的眼睑，开始带着千年的沉重感极其缓慢地向上掀起。一道璀璨的金色光芒率先从狭窄的眼缝中迸发，瞬间刺破了周围的薄雾，随即，眼睑完全张开，露出两颗如同熔融黄金般燃烧的竖瞳，这霸道而威严的光芒将龙首周围的岩石染上了一层神圣的金色。整个画面在冷峻的蓝灰色调与这抹温暖而充满力量的金色之间形成强烈对比，充满了庄严、神秘的武侠史诗感，仿佛一个沉睡了万古的传奇正在苏醒。
prompt: An epic long shot, shot from a slightly upward angle, slowly and imperceptibly advances, deep into a landscape resembling an ink painting of mountains bathed in the shimmering light of dawn. A vast, azure-green Eastern dragon, like a winding mountain range, its massive body perched layer upon layer atop the precipitous peaks. Its scales gleam with a cold, hard sheen of metal and jade in the cool light. The milky white sea of clouds flowing across the valley barely covers half of its body. The dragon's head drooped, its majestic horns like withered branches, its long whiskers swaying gently in the mountain breeze. Suddenly, its eyelids, textured like rock, slowly and with the weight of millennia, began to lift. A brilliant golden light burst forth from the narrow slits of its eyes, instantly piercing the surrounding mist. Then, the eyelids opened fully, revealing two vertical pupils blazing like molten gold. This domineering and majestic light stained the rock surrounding the dragon's head with a sacred golden hue. The whole picture forms a sharp contrast between the cold blue-gray tones and the warm and powerful gold, full of solemn and mysterious martial arts epic feeling, as if a legend that has been sleeping for eternity is awakening.

prompt_cn: 一个极慢动作的仰拍镜头，相机紧贴着地面向上，轻微平移以追踪一辆深森林绿色的改装越野车的运动轨迹，它刚刚从一座高耸金色沙丘的陡峭顶部猛然腾空而起。厚重、湿润的深棕色泥浆溅满了整个车身，从加固的钢制保险杠一直覆盖到车顶的探照灯条，整个底盘在跳跃的最高点完全悬挂在广阔、无云的湛蓝天空中。其巨大的、沾满泥浆的超大越野轮胎在半空中疯狂而徒劳地旋转着，形成一圈动态模糊，清晰可见的胎面花纹将细小的沙粒和泥浆水滴以一种壮观的、凝固的喷射状向外甩开。正午刺眼而直接的阳光在湿润的泥浆和车辆的金属表面上闪烁着刺眼的光芒，为整个画面注入了一种原始力量、高能动作和激动人心的自由感，将这个戏剧性的、反重力的瞬间定格成一幅充满张力的视觉诗篇。
prompt: super-slow-motion overhead shot, the camera hovering close to the ground, pans slightly to track the trajectory of a deep forest green modified SUV as it suddenly soars into the air from the steep crest of a towering golden sand dune. Thick, wet, dark brown mud splatters the vehicle's entire body, from its reinforced steel bumpers to the roof's searchlight bar. At the peak of its leap, the entire chassis hangs suspended in the vast, cloudless blue sky. Its massive, mud-soaked, oversized off-road tires spin frantically and futilely in mid-air, creating a circle of motion blur. The clearly visible tread pattern flings tiny grains of sand and mud droplets outward in a spectacular, frozen spray. The harsh, direct midday sun shimmers glaringly on the wet mud and the vehicle's metallic surface, imbuing the entire image with a sense of raw power, high-energy action, and a thrilling sense of freedom, freezing this dramatic, gravity-defying moment into a tense visual poem.

prompt_cn: 一个史诗般的无人机空中镜头，以稳定而宏大的姿态，缓慢地围绕着标志性的广州塔进行顺时针旋转，整个画面具有赛事转播级别的超高清清晰度。在塔尖之上，一团山脉般巨大的积雨云正汹涌地翻滚、汇聚，云体呈现出深邃的靛蓝色与不祥的铅灰色，边缘被狂风撕扯成动态的絮状。广州塔标志性的扭转式钢结构格栅在风暴前夕阴沉的天光下呈现出冷峻的金属质感，与下方开始亮起零星灯火的城市景观形成鲜明对比。云层深处，一道道无声的电光以不规则的节奏猛烈闪烁，瞬间将庞大的云团从内部照亮，暴露出其令人敬畏的、充满能量的内部结构，仿佛一头正在苏醒的巨兽。这壮丽而紧张的景象将现代都市地标与末日般的自然伟力并置，营造出一种风暴即将吞噬一切的、令人窒息的末日氛围。
prompt: An epic drone aerial shot, steady and majestic, slowly rotates clockwise around the iconic Canton Tower, the entire image captured in ultra-high-definition resolution, perfect for sports broadcasts. Above the tower's spire, a mountain-sized cumulonimbus cloud churns and converges violently, its mass shimmering in deep indigo and ominous leaden gray, its edges ripped into dynamic flocculence by the wind. Under the gloomy sky before the storm, the Canton Tower's signature twisted steel lattice takes on a cold metallic quality, a stark contrast to the cityscape below, which is beginning to light up sporadically. Deep within the clouds, silent flashes of lightning flicker violently in an irregular rhythm, momentarily illuminating the vast mass from within, revealing its awe-inspiring, energetic interior, like a behemoth awakening. This magnificent and tense scene juxtaposes a modern urban landmark with the apocalyptic forces of nature, creating a suffocating, apocalyptic atmosphere, as if a storm is about to engulf everything.

prompt_cn: 以令人惊叹的新海诚风格，静态低角度中镜头以清脆的高帧率和戏剧性的慢动作捕捉场景，标志性的奥迪Sport Quattro S1在砾石拉力赛舞台上执行暴力发射。该车经典的白色底盘，装饰着标志性的红色、灰色和黑色赛车条纹，在巨大的扭矩下，悬挂在悬挂装置上。相机的焦点固定在后轮上，一个深胎面的拉力轮胎猛烈地旋转，它的胎面抓着并咬入松散的砾石表面，发出爆炸性的岩石阵雨和厚厚的细尘羽状喷向空中。整个场景由明亮、低垂的太阳背光，创造出一个宏伟而广阔的变形镜头耀斑，在画面上水平条纹，带有充满活力的蓝色和橙色。夕阳将天空描绘成新海标志性的深紫色、火热的橙子和柔和的粉红色，投射出长长的戏剧性阴影，使空中的每颗鹅卵石都像一颗微小的悬浮宝石一样闪闪发光。氛围是原始机械力与空灵、短暂的美丽的强大融合，捕捉到了凝固在时间中的单一、史诗般的时刻。
prompt: In stunning Makoto Shinkai style, a static low-angle medium shot captures the scene with crisp high frame rates and dramatic slow motion as the iconic Audi Sport Quattro S1 executes a violent launch across a gravel rally stage. The car's classic white chassis, adorned with signature red, gray, and black racing stripes, sways from its suspension under immense torque. The camera's focus is fixed on the rear wheel as a deeply treaded rally tire spins violently, its tread clawing and biting into the loose gravel surface, sending explosive showers of rock and thick plumes of fine dust into the air. The entire scene is backlit by a bright, low-hanging sun, creating a magnificent, expansive anamorphic lens flare that streaks horizontally across the frame with vibrant blues and oranges. The setting sun paints the sky in Shinkai's signature hues of deep purple, fiery orange, and soft pink, casting long, dramatic shadows and making every pebble in the air shimmer like a tiny suspended gem. The atmosphere is a powerful fusion of raw mechanical force and ethereal, ephemeral beauty, capturing a single, epic moment frozen in time.

prompt_cn: 一个新闻纪实风格的长镜头，从平视角度开始，缓缓地向内推近，聚焦于一位年迈的清宫总管太监，他正独自站在紫禁城一间静谧书房的雕花木窗旁。午后柔和的阳光透过窗格上的薄纸，斜斜地洒进来，在空气中勾勒出飞舞的尘埃，也照亮了他身上那件深蓝色暗花绸缎总管常服的精致纹理。他年约花甲，前额光亮，脑后的花白发辫垂至腰间，一张苍白而布满细纹的脸上毫无表情，唯有戴在右手拇指上的墨绿色玉扳指在光线下透出温润的光泽。他双手小心翼翼地捧着一本明黄色的奏折，修长的手指稳定而从容地沿着奏折上工整的馆阁体毛笔字缓缓移动，随着他读到某一处，他用指尖轻轻捻起一页，动作轻缓得几乎没有发出一丝声响。就在此时，镜头已经推至他的面部特写，清晰地捕捉到他一直波澜不惊的脸上瞬间闪过的一丝复杂神情：他的眉头极轻微地一蹙，眼神从专注的阅读中抽离，短暂地望向虚空，瞳孔中混合着一丝惊异与深沉的算计，随即嘴角不易察觉地向下一沉，但这一切仅持续了不到一秒，他的表情便迅速恢复了那副惯有的、深不可测的平静，整个过程在极致的安静中完成，营造出一种信息量巨大却又秘而不宣的紧张氛围。
prompt: long, newsreel-style shot, starting at eye level and slowly zooming in, focuses on an elderly eunuch, the chief eunuch of the Qing Dynasty, standing alone by a carved wooden window in a quiet study in the Forbidden City. Soft afternoon sunlight slanted through the thin paper covering the window pane, skewing the air with dancing dust and illuminating the delicate texture of his dark blue satin uniform, a patterned pattern. He was about sixty years old, with a shiny forehead and a head of graying hair that hung down to his waist. His pale, finely lined face was expressionless, only the dark green jade ring on his right thumb gleamed in the warm light. Carefully, his hands held a bright yellow memorial, his slender fingers moving steadily and deliberately along the neatly written calligraphy of the imperial court. As he reached a certain point, he gently lifted a page with his fingertips, his movements so gentle that they made almost no sound. At this moment, the camera has moved to a close-up of his face, clearly capturing a complex expression that flashed across his usually calm face: his brows frowned very slightly, his eyes withdrew from his concentrated reading, and briefly looked into the void, with a mixture of surprise and deep calculation in his pupils, and then the corners of his mouth sank imperceptibly, but all this lasted for less than a second, and his expression quickly returned to his usual, unfathomable calm. The whole process was completed in extreme silence, creating a tense atmosphere that contained a huge amount of information but was kept secret.

prompt_cn: 在一个极致的特写镜头中，画面以略微俯瞰的角度，呈现出一种精致的静物摄影美学。一束柔和、温暖的侧光从画面左侧斜射而入，照亮了深色木质茶盘上的场景。一双修长白皙、指甲修剪得干净整洁的优雅的手，正稳定而从容地握着一把长嘴细流的银色水壶，将一股滚烫的热水以一道纤细而精准的水柱，小心翼翼地注入一个晶莹剔透的无柄玻璃公道杯中。杯底静卧着一小撮蜷曲如螺、茸毛遍布的嫩绿色碧螺春干茶叶，随着水流的冲击，它们瞬间被唤醒，在清澈的热水中急速盘旋、翻滚。此时，摄像机开始缓慢地向右平移，紧紧跟随茶叶的变化，捕捉到它们缓缓舒展开蜷缩的身体，嫩芽在水中完全伸展的瞬间，一缕缕淡雅的黄绿色茶汤从叶片中氤氲而出，逐渐将整杯水染上通透的色泽，袅袅升起的水汽在光线中变得清晰可见，营造出一种宁静、专注而治愈的氛围。
prompt: In an extreme close-up, the image, captured from a slightly bird's-eye view, captures the aesthetic of a refined still life. A soft, warm sidelight streams in from the left, illuminating the scene on the dark wooden tea tray. A pair of slender, white hands, their nails neatly manicured, steadily and calmly grip a silver kettle with a long, thin spout. With a slender, precise stream, they carefully pour boiling water into a crystal-clear, handleless glass cup. At the bottom of the cup rests a handful of tender green Biluochun dry tea leaves, curled like a snail and covered in fine hairs. The rush of water instantly awakens them, swirling and tumbling rapidly in the clear water. prompt_cn: 一个极具动感的头部追踪特写镜头，紧紧跟随一名年轻的亚洲骑手，他正驾驭着一辆哑光黑色的液压碟刹攀爬自行车。在一条狭窄、湿漉漉的香港后巷里，他正小心翼翼地进行着一个高难度的原地平衡动作。雨水打湿了他乌黑的短发，几缕发丝紧贴在他棱角分明的脸庞上，汗水与雨水混合着从他专注的眉眼间滑落。他身穿一件宽松的深蓝色防水冲锋衣，拉链半开，露出里面一件简单的灰色棉质T恤。他身体重心极低，通过手腕对宽大车把的微调和身体的轻微摇摆来维持着脆弱的平衡。脚下是湿滑的沥青地面，积水中倒映着两侧墙壁上层层叠叠的褪色海报和头顶五光十色的霓虹灯招牌——主要是深红、宝蓝和翠绿色——投下的迷离光线。这些流光溢彩的光芒在他冲锋衣的防水面料和自行车的金属车架上反射出不断变幻的光斑，每一次为了稳定而对液压碟刹的精妙控制，都伴随着一声几乎听不见的、清脆的摩擦声。整个画面充满了高对比度的光影、饱和的色彩和一种专注而孤独的氛围，完美复现了港风怀旧电影的独特美学与质感。
prompt: striking head-tracking close-up follows a young Asian cyclist as he steers a matte black climbing bike with hydraulic disc brakes. In a narrow, wet Hong Kong back alley, he carefully performs a challenging balancing act. Rain dampens his short, dark hair, strands plastering his angular features. The entire scene is filled with high-contrast light and shadow, saturated colors, and an atmosphere of focused loneliness, perfectly recreating the unique aesthetic and texture of nostalgic Hong Kong films.

prompt_cn: 一张静态的、与眼睛齐平的中等特写，以鲜明的黑白插图风格呈现，由干净、大胆的线条和极高的对比度定义，捕捉到了一位令人敬畏的女性。她留着一个别致、锋利的黑色波波头，衬托着她的脸，嘴唇上挂着自信、会意的傻笑。她坐在月光下的顶层公寓里的一张豪华现代扶手椅上，她的身材穿着一件光滑、合身的黑色连衣裙，可以吸收光线。在她身后，灿烂的月光透过落地窗倾泻而下，以戏剧性的黑白对比效果划过整个房间，创造出深邃的墨水阴影。她优雅的食指优雅地优雅地沿着手中一只长柄酒杯的精致边缘轻轻划过。随着这种催眠动作的展开，她的眼睛带着淡淡、空灵的白色光芒，直接锁定在镜头上。与此同时，她头部和肩膀周围的空气开始扭曲，被想象为一个由干净、旋转的图形线组成的微妙的心灵能量漩涡，这些图形线弯曲和扭曲了背景，在高对比度的单色世界中创造了一种紧张而强大的受控超自然力量的氛围。
prompt: static, eye-level medium close-up, rendered in a stark black and white illustrative style defined by clean, bold lines and extreme contrast, captures a formidable woman. She sports a chic, sharp black bob that frames her face, a confident, knowing smile on her lips. She sits in a plush, modern armchair in a moonlit penthouse apartment, her figure clad in a sleek, form-fitting black dress that absorbs the light. With graceful grace, her elegant index finger traces the delicate rim of a long-stemmed wine glass in her hand. At the same time, the air around her head and shoulders begins to twist, imagined as a subtle vortex of psychic energy composed of clean, swirling graphic lines that bend and distort the background, creating a tense and powerful atmosphere of controlled supernatural forces within the high-contrast monochrome world.

prompt_cn: 一张框架严密的水下特写镜头，以高速自然摄影的令人惊叹的细节呈现，以令人惊叹的慢动作侧向追踪，捕捉捕食的原始时刻。一只巨大的、鱼雷形状的长鼻雀羚，它的身体覆盖着一层相互交织的钻石形状的黑色鳞片，闪烁着橄榄绿和青铜色的彩虹色，以爆炸性的速度冲刺。阳光透过水面过滤，在其形状上产生变化的焦散图案。它长长的骨头鼻子微微张开，露出一排排锋利得可怕的半透明针状牙齿。它攻击的目标是一只小得多的银色鳞片黑鼻鱼，它在昏暗的灯光下闪烁，绝望地向侧面冲去，它的鳍张开，身体在极度恐慌中扭曲。来自雀鳝尾巴的强大的、鞭子般的推进力剧烈地搅动着水，创造出可见的漩涡和微小的、闪闪发光的气泡和扰动的沉积物的痕迹，这些气泡和沉积物在两条鱼周围盘旋，所有这些都冻结在慢动作捕捉的超现实清晰度中，创造出一种紧张而戏剧性的生死追逐气氛。
prompt: tightly framed underwater close-up, rendered with the breathtaking detail of high-speed nature photography, tracks sideways in stunning slow motion, capturing the primal moment of predation. A massive, torpedo-shaped longnose gar, its body covered in a cacophony of interwoven, diamond-shaped black scales shimmering with iridescent hues of olive green and bronze, dashes at explosive speed. Sunlight filters through the water, creating shifting caustic patterns across its form. Its long, bony snout flares slightly, revealing rows of terrifyingly sharp, translucent, needle-like teeth. Its target, a much smaller, silver-scaled blacknose fish, gleams in the dim light and desperately lunges sideways, its fins flared and its body contorted in sheer panic. The powerful, whip-like propulsion from the gar's tail violently churns the water, creating visible eddies and trails of tiny, shimmering bubbles and disturbed sediment that swirl around the two fish, all frozen in the surreal clarity of slow motion, creating the tense and dramatic atmosphere of a life-or-death chase.

prompt_cn: 一个极致慢动作的特写镜头，采用轻微的向下倾斜运镜，精准地跟随一颗饱满的深红色苹果。起初，这颗苹果静静地悬挂在一根布满青苔的粗糙树枝上，其光滑如蜡的表皮上覆盖着一层细密的、晶莹剔透的球形水珠。清晨柔和的金色阳光从侧后方斜射而来，为苹果勾勒出一圈明亮的轮廓光，并让每一颗水珠都闪烁着钻石般的光芒。随着果柄与树枝连接处一声几乎不可闻的断裂，苹果开始其缓慢而优雅的下坠之旅，在空中进行着轻微的、不规则的旋转。随着它的运动，附着其上的水珠被离心力轻柔地甩出，在空中拉伸成一道道微小而闪亮的弧线轨迹，每一滴都在阳光的照射下折射出瞬息即逝的微型彩虹。背景是完全失焦的、被晨雾笼罩的翠绿果园，模糊的叶片边缘也挂着同样的露珠，整个画面色调温暖，充满了极致宁静与生命诗意的氛围，将一个自然发生的瞬间定格为一幅充满动态美感的视觉诗篇。
prompt: stunningly slow-motion close-up, captured with a gentle downward tilt, precisely follows a plump, crimson apple. Initially, the apple hangs quietly from a gnarled, mossy branch, its waxy skin coated in a dense layer of fine, crystalline spherical water droplets. Soft, golden morning sunlight slants in from behind, framing the apple in a brilliant halo and making each drop sparkle like a diamond. With a barely audible snap where the stem meets the branch, the apple begins its slow, graceful descent, spinning slightly and irregularly through the air. As it moves, the clinging water droplets are gently flung away by centrifugal force, stretching them into tiny, shimmering arcs in the air. Each droplet, caught in the sunlight, creates a fleeting miniature rainbow. The background is a completely out-of-focus, emerald green orchard shrouded in morning mist. The same dewdrops hang on the blurred edges of the leaves. The whole picture is warm in color, full of an atmosphere of extreme tranquility and the poetry of life, freezing a naturally occurring moment into a visual poem full of dynamic beauty.

prompt_cn: 一个从平视角度拍摄的静态特写镜头，聚焦于一双被医用级别的蓝色丁腈手套紧紧包裹的双手，它们正小心翼翼地捏着一支透明的玻璃试管。在明亮而均匀的冷色调顶光照射下，手套光滑的表面反射出柔和的高光，背景是一个略微失焦的现代化实验室，隐约可见不锈钢仪器外壳的金属光泽和远处闪烁的设备指示灯。试管内，一种清澈的液体正剧烈地冒着细密的气泡，气泡从管底源源不断地上升、破裂。这双手以一种稳定而从容的节奏，缓缓地将试管从画面下方举起，最终将其停在镜头正前方，仿佛在向观察者无声地展示这一化学反应的动态过程，光线穿透试管中的液体，让每一个上升的气泡都显得晶莹剔透，整个画面充满了科学的严谨感和专注的探索氛围。
prompt: static close-up shot from a horizontal angle focuses on a pair of hands tightly wrapped in medical-grade blue nitrile gloves, carefully gripping a clear glass test tube. Bright, evenly lit by cool overhead lighting, the gloves' smooth surface reflects soft highlights. A slightly out-of-focus modern laboratory is visible in the background, with the metallic sheen of stainless steel instruments and blinking indicator lights in the distance. Within the test tube, a clear liquid is violently bubbling with tiny bubbles, which continuously rise and burst from the bottom. With a steady and deliberate rhythm, the hands slowly lift the test tube from the bottom of the frame, finally bringing it to rest directly in front of the camera, as if silently demonstrating the dynamic process of this chemical reaction to the viewer. Light penetrates the liquid within the test tube, making each rising bubble appear crystal clear. The entire image is imbued with scientific rigor and an atmosphere of focused exploration.

prompt_cn: 一张与视线齐平、流畅的侧轨镜头跟随两个人一起骑自行车，沿着一条穿过广阔草地的狭窄土路。摄像机与它们平行移动，保持一致的距离。左边的人是一位留着长发的女性，穿着一件飘逸的及膝白色背心裙，由浅色棉质制成，在微风中轻轻飘扬。她驾驶着一辆经典的巡洋舰自行车，前面装饰着一个编织的柳条篮，踏板节奏稳定、轻松，脸上挂着宁静的微笑。在她的右边，一名穿着无袖运动衬衫和深色短裤的男子骑着一辆看起来更现代的自行车，他的姿势笔直、专注。他们都连续向前移动，双腿以同步、悠闲的方式跳动。环境沐浴在部分多云的下午温暖柔和的光线中，照亮了高高的草丛充满活力的绿色。在背景中，远处一排茂密的树木映衬着淡蓝色的天空，点缀着柔软的白色云层，静态的背景强调了骑自行车的人稳步前进，并营造出一种和平、田园诗般的宁静氛围。
prompt: flowing, eye-level sidetrack shot follows two people cycling together along a narrow dirt path through a vast meadow. The camera moves parallel to them, maintaining a consistent distance. The static backdrop emphasizes the cyclists' steady progress and creates an atmosphere of peaceful, idyllic tranquility.

prompt_cn: 一个极端特写镜头，相机保持静止，以平视角度聚焦于一个纯黑色的虚无空间中，一个形态完美、表面如白瓷般光滑的苹果。一束强烈的、戏剧性的顶光从正上方打下，雕刻出其饱满的轮廓，并在其顶部投下一片耀眼的高光，营造出极致的、鲜明的黑白对比效果。起初，苹果静止不动，但很快，其洁白无瑕的表皮上开始毫无征兆地浮现出蛛网般的黑色细微裂纹，这些裂纹以一种有机而诡异的方式迅速蔓延、加深。紧接着，浓稠如墨的黑色液体从裂缝中缓缓渗出，沿着苹果光滑的曲面蜿蜒流下，液体的粘稠质感在强光下反射出微弱而扭曲的光泽。苹果的固体结构随之开始瓦解，在一种缓慢而不可逆转的过程中向内塌陷、变形，最终完全溶解，化为一滩在漆黑反光地面上平静摊开的深色液体，整个过程充满了超现实主义的张力与一种冰冷、抽象的毁灭之美。
prompt: In an extreme close-up, the camera remains stationary, focused at eye level on a perfectly formed apple, its surface as smooth as white porcelain, nestled within a void of pure black. A powerful, dramatic overhead light, directed from directly above, sculpts its sculpted contours and casts a dazzling highlight on its crown, creating an extreme, stark contrast between black and white. At first, the apple remains motionless, but soon, without warning, a web of tiny black cracks begins to appear on its flawless white skin, rapidly spreading and deepening in an organic and eerie pattern. Then, a thick, inky black liquid slowly seeps from the cracks, snaking down the apple's smooth, curved surface. The liquid's viscous texture reflects a faint, distorted sheen in the strong light. The solid structure of the apple then begins to disintegrate, collapsing and deforming inwards in a slow and irreversible process, and finally dissolving completely, turning into a pool of dark liquid that spreads calmly on the dark, reflective ground. The whole process is full of surreal tension and a cold, abstract beauty of destruction.

prompt_cn: 一张静态高清微距镜头，以韩国传统美学的精致水彩风格渲染，捕捉到了一只又长又细的管形千足虫。最初，这种生物呈一个紧密、完美的螺旋状，它苍白、几乎珍珠般的身体优雅地盘在一根多节、饱经风霜的树枝上，树枝上布满了毛茸茸的、潮湿的苔藓。场景由柔和的漫反射光照亮，该光透过看不见的树冠，在千足虫的分段形式上产生柔和的光芒，并消除任何刺耳的阴影。千足虫以平静而流畅的动作开始展开;它的头部故意抬起，身体的其余部分随之形成单一的、完整的、令人着迷的波浪。随着它的延伸，它无数的、纤细的、毛发状的腿沿着它的长度呈催眠的、协调的瀑布状波纹。背景是极简主义的、失焦的淡绿色和泥土棕色，暗示着薄雾的森林背景，同时将焦点完全集中在生物优雅的动作上，创造出一种宁静、沉思的氛围，具有深刻的自然美。
prompt: single, still, high-definition macro shot, rendered in a delicate watercolor style inspired by traditional Korean aesthetics, captures a long, slender, tube-shaped millipede. Initially, the creature appears in a tight, perfect spiral, its pale, almost pearly body gracefully coiled around a gnarled, weathered branch covered in furry, damp moss. The scene is illuminated by soft, diffuse light that filters through the invisible tree canopy, casting a gentle glow on the millipede's segmented form and eliminating any harsh shadows. With a calm, fluid movement, the millipede begins to unfurl; its head deliberately lifts, and the rest of its body follows in a single, unbroken, mesmerizing wave. prompt_cn: 一张静态的、与眼睛齐平的中等特写镜头捕捉到了一名坐在一把现代化的白色模制塑料沙龙椅子上的女士，椅子上有抛光的镀铬扶手。她的肩膀上披着一件光滑的黑色尼龙斗篷，她的长发的许多部分都精心包裹在闪闪发光的银铝箔中，这表明她正在接受化学头发治疗。她的脸由箔纸包裹着，用大胆的哑光红色口红精心化妆，与场景中中性的调色板形成鲜明对比。她的表情是一种凝固的恐惧时刻;她的眼睛睁得大大的，眉毛微微拱起，当她凝视着镜头时，她的嘴唇张开，无声地发出关心或惊讶的喘息声。场景沐浴在头顶专业沙龙固定装置发出的明亮、均匀的光线中，消除了刺耳的阴影，营造出干净、临床的感觉，并在箔纸上柔和地反射。背景柔和地失焦，揭示了原始、组织良好的沙龙环境的模糊轮廓，其中有一面大镜子和另一个空荡荡的站，加强了专业的环境，同时让观众的注意力锁定在女人身上。单调、明亮的灯光和她脆弱、不确定的表情结合在一起，营造了一种明显的紧张期待氛围，完全专注于她在变革过程中的个人反应。
prompt: static, eye-level medium close-up captures a woman seated in a modern, white, molded-plastic salon chair with polished chrome armrests. The monotonous, bright lighting and her fragile, uncertain expression combine to create a palpable atmosphere of tense anticipation, focusing entirely on her personal reactions during the transformation.

prompt_cn: 从静态的第一人称视角来看，一个极端的特写镜头捕捉到了一个华丽的发夹，摇摇欲坠地平衡在深色木制梳妆台的圆形抛光边缘上。整个场景以文艺复兴时期油画的风格呈现，由戏剧性的黑白灯光和丰富、明显的纹理定义。发夹本身就是一件古典细节的杰作，其主体由一块深乳白色的玉雕刻成复杂的花卉图案。精致的银色链穗悬挂在银色底座上，缓慢而迷人地摇摆着。当它移动时，一道强烈的温暖光线，就像来自附近的蜡烛一样，照射在抛光的表面上;它照亮了玉的半透明深处，使其从内部发光，并在精心制作的银上发出尖锐、转瞬即逝的光芒。发夹犹豫不决，它温柔而有节奏的动作在梳妆台光滑的表面和失焦背景的天鹅绒般的黑暗上投射出深刻的、柔和的边缘阴影的映衬下，营造出一种深刻的张力和脆弱的美感。
prompt: From a static, first-person perspective, an extreme close-up captures an ornate hairpin, precariously balanced on the rounded, polished edge of a dark wooden dressing table. The scene is rendered in the style of a Renaissance painting, defined by dramatic black-and-white lighting and rich, pronounced textures. The hairpin itself is a masterpiece of classical detail, its body carved from a single block of deep, opalescent jade into an intricate floral pattern. A delicate silver chain tassel dangles from its silver base, swaying slowly and captivatingly. As it moves, an intense, warm light, like that from a nearby candle, illuminates the polished surface; it illuminates the jade's translucent depths, causing it to glow from within, and casts sharp, fleeting gleams on the meticulously crafted silver. The hairpin's hesitant movements, its gentle, rhythmic movements casting deep, soft shadows against the smooth surface of the dressing table and the velvety darkness of the out-of-focus background, create a profound sense of tension and fragile beauty.

prompt_cn: 从高角度鸟瞰，相机保持一个完美的中心组成，因为它慢慢地拉回来，揭示了一个巨大的，发光的地形图渲染与清晰的数字美学。这幅地图由复杂而明亮的青色轮廓线组成，背景是深蓝色，几乎是黑色，代表了一个程式化的全国性景观。突然，代表新建的5G基站的明亮白光点开始在地图上依次激活，每个点都发出柔和而有节奏的光芒。从这些激活的站点，动画光脉冲流，可视化为快速，充满活力的数据包，发射并沿着预先存在的薄，发光的光纤线路网络高速行进。当数据包穿越网络时，它们所传输的线路会发出更明亮、更强烈的白色光，创造出令人眼花缭乱的信息流视觉，并在整个数字景观中迅速传播。摄像头缓慢、持续的向后移动逐渐揭示了这一智能基础设施在全国范围内的巨大规模，强调了不断扩张的5G网络的全面性和互联性，并营造了一种复杂、未来主义和动态的进步和连接氛围。
prompt: From a high-angle bird's-eye view, the camera maintains a perfectly centered composition as it slowly pulls back to reveal a vast, glowing topographic map rendered with a sharp digital aesthetic. Composed of intricate, bright cyan contours against a deep, almost black background, the map represents a stylized nationwide landscape. Suddenly, bright white dots representing newly constructed 5G base stations begin to activate one after another across the map, each emitting a soft, rhythmic glow. From these activated sites, animated light pulses, visualized as rapid, vibrant data packets, are emitted and travel at high speed along a pre-existing network of thin, glowing fiber optic lines. As the packets traverse the network, the lines they travel along glow brighter and more intensely white, creating a dazzling visual of information flowing rapidly across the digital landscape. The camera's slow, continuous backward movement gradually reveals the vast nationwide scale of this intelligent infrastructure, emphasizing the comprehensiveness and interconnectedness of the expanding 5G network and creating a complex, futuristic, and dynamic atmosphere of progress and connectivity.

prompt_cn: 一个通过极端鱼眼镜头捕捉的、令人眩晕的高速垂直下潜镜头，将观众的视角猛地推入一个由无数流动光粒子构成的宏大全息城市模型之中。在这个被严重扭曲的超广角视野里，原本垂直的摩天大楼的轮廓被弯曲成弧形，向画面的中心汇聚，形成一个巨大的视觉漩涡。这些建筑并非实体，而是由闪烁着电光蓝与青色光芒的半透明粒子构成的空灵框架，其内部结构清晰可见。与此同时，无数由二进制代码和几何图形组成的、充满活力的品红色数据流，如同瀑布般沿着建筑的虚拟表面飞速下泻和盘旋，在镜头前拉出长长的光轨。随着下潜速度的急剧加快，周围的一切都化为一片模糊而动态的光之海洋，营造出一种穿越数字维度、信息过载的强烈沉浸感和令人目不暇接的科幻氛围。
prompt: dizzying, high-speed vertical dive captured through an extreme fisheye lens thrusts the viewer's perspective into a vast holographic city model composed of countless flowing light particles. Within this severely distorted, ultra-wide-angle view, the once-vertical silhouettes of skyscrapers are curved into arcs, converging toward the center of the frame, forming a vast visual vortex. These buildings are not physical entities, but ethereal frameworks composed of translucent particles shimmering in electric blue and cyan, their internal structures clearly visible. Simultaneously, countless vibrant magenta streams of binary code and geometric shapes cascade and spiral along the virtual surfaces of the buildings, leaving long light trails in front of the camera. As the dive accelerates, everything around them transforms into a blurry, dynamic sea of light, creating a powerful sense of immersion in a digital dimension, information overload, and a dizzying sci-fi atmosphere.

prompt_cn: 一个从侧方低角度拍摄的微距特写镜头，相机保持静止，将焦点完全集中在静谧黑暗花园中的一朵含苞待放的昙花上。清冷的银色月光是唯一的光源，为整个场景笼罩上一层神秘而宁静的氛围，背景是模糊失焦的深色枝叶。起初，花苞紧紧闭合，深绿色的外层苞片包裹着内部隐约可见的雪白。随着时间的流逝，最外层的苞片开始微微颤动，然后极其缓慢而优雅地向后剥离。紧接着，内部雪白的瓣叶开始了一场无声的舞蹈，它们小心翼翼地从中心向外舒卷，一层一层，从容不迫地绽放开来。每一片花瓣都薄如蝉翼，在月光的映照下呈现出半透明的质感和柔和的蜡质光泽，光线穿透花瓣的边缘，勾勒出清晰而圣洁的轮廓，同时在花瓣的褶皱间投下深邃而柔和的阴影。最终，整朵花完全盛开，形成一个巨大而完美的白色圣杯，露出中心一簇淡黄色的纤细花蕊，整个过程充满了生命苏醒的奇迹感和转瞬即逝的极致之美，画面色调以冷峻的蓝黑与纯粹的亮白形成强烈对比，营造出一种神圣而又忧伤的诗意。
prompt: macro close-up shot from a low side angle, the camera remains still, focusing completely on a budding Epiphyllum in the quiet, dark garden. The cool, silvery moonlight provides the sole source of light, shrouding the scene in a mysterious and tranquil atmosphere, against a backdrop of blurred, out-of-focus dark foliage. Initially, the bud is tightly closed, its deep green outer bracts enveloping the faintly glimpsed snow-white interior. As time passes, the outermost bracts begin to tremble slightly, then peel back with exquisite slowness and grace. Immediately, the snow-white inner petals begin a silent dance, carefully unfurling from the center outward, layer by layer, unhurriedly opening. Each petal is as thin as a cicada's wing, translucent in the moonlight, its soft, waxy sheen gleaming. Light filters through the petals' edges, outlining their sharp, chaste contours while casting deep, soft shadows within their folds. Finally, the entire flower blooms fully, forming a huge and perfect white chalice, revealing a cluster of delicate pale yellow stamens in the center. The whole process is filled with the miracle of life awakening and the ultimate beauty of fleetingness. The color tone of the picture forms a sharp contrast with the cold blue-black and pure bright white, creating a sacred and sad poetry.

prompt_cn: 在一个从地面向上仰拍的极端慢动作镜头中，整个世界被重塑为一幅充满童趣的儿童画。画面中央是一片紫线青皮竹林，每一根竹竿都不是完美的圆柱体，而是用稚嫩的笔触勾勒出的、略带歪斜的绿色蜡笔线条，色彩填充得并不完全均匀，显露出纸张般的纹理。在这些苹果绿色的竹竿上，一道道醒目的紫色竖直条纹被用力地画了上去，线条边缘带着蜡笔特有的粗糙感。在几乎静止的时间流里，这片竹林正以一种梦幻般几乎不可察觉的幅度轻轻摇曳，竹叶被简化为一片片深绿色的剪纸形状，随着竹竿的摆动而轻微颤动。最引人注目的是，随着竹竿的每一次微小弯曲，那些紫色的条纹仿佛在缓慢地伸展与收缩，实现了“呼吸”般的生命感。背景是一片平涂的、柔和的土黄色大地和蔚蓝色的天空，天空中点缀着几朵棉花糖般蓬松的白色云朵，角落里一个带着笑脸的巨大黄色太阳，洒下温暖而均匀的光芒，为这个宁静、天真烂漫的童话场景注入了无限的温柔与遐想。
prompt: In an extreme slow-motion shot shot from the ground, the world is reimagined as a child's drawing, brimming with playful innocence. At the center of the frame lies a forest of purple-lined, green-skinned bamboo. Each bamboo pole is not a perfect cylinder, but rather a slightly skewed, crayon-like line drawn with childish strokes. The color is unevenly filled, revealing a paper-like texture. Striking vertical purple stripes are meticulously inscribed on these apple-green poles, their edges tinged with the characteristic roughness of crayon. In the almost static flow of time, the bamboo forest sways with a dreamlike, almost imperceptible movement. The bamboo leaves, simplified into dark green paper-cut shapes, tremble subtly with the swaying of the poles. Most strikingly, with each subtle bend of the poles, the purple stripes appear to slowly expand and contract, creating a sense of life, akin to "breathing." The background is a flat, soft ochre earth and azure sky, dotted with a few fluffy white clouds like cotton candy. In the corner, a huge yellow sun with a smiling face casts warm and even light, injecting infinite tenderness and reverie into this quiet, innocent fairy tale scene.

prompt_cn: 静态的、自上而下的鸟瞰图捕捉到了纯粹的烹饪艺术场景，优雅的菜单印刷在厚厚的奶油色卡片纸上，带有微妙的纹理，表现出缓慢、稳定和深思熟虑的圆形运动，保持完美的中心位置。框架。柔和、温暖的餐厅灯光，就像来自头顶上聚焦的聚光灯，捕捉到了颓废甜点华丽的金箔浮雕名称，使文字在哑光纸上闪烁着金属光泽。菜单呈现在深色桃花心木表面上，经过抛光，可以反射温暖的光线，具有深厚的液体光泽。这个中心主题由充满活力的乌藨子酒的巧妙、有光泽的漩涡和精心排列在木头上的精致、如雪般的糖粉制成的精美框架。当菜单完成优雅的旋转时，柔和、半透明的蒸汽徐徐飘过框架，暂时软化了细节，增强了华丽展示的令人垂涎欲滴的奢华氛围。
prompt: Capturing a scene of pure culinary artistry, the elegant menu, printed on thick cream-colored cardstock with a subtle texture, exhibits slow, steady, and deliberate circular motion, maintaining a perfect centerpiece. Soft, warm restaurant lighting, like a focused spotlight overhead, captures the decadent dessert's gorgeous gold-foil embossed names, giving the text a metallic sheen against the matte paper. The menu is presented on a dark mahogany surface, polished to reflect the warm light and possess a deep, liquid sheen. This central motif is beautifully framed by artful, lustrous swirls of vibrant oolong wine and delicate, snow-like powdered sugar meticulously arranged on the wood. As the menu completes its graceful rotation, soft, translucent vapor drifts across the frame, momentarily softening the details and enhancing the mouth-watering, luxurious atmosphere of the opulent presentation.

prompt_cn: 一个从平视角度拍摄的固定远景镜头，静静地捕捉着公园清晨的宁静一刻。画面中央，一对头发全然花白的年迈夫妇正站在一片青翠欲滴的草坪上，他们身穿宽松飘逸的白色丝绸太极服，在晨曦中显得格外醒目。清晨的薄雾尚未完全散去，在空气中弥漫成一层淡淡的、柔和的纱幔，第一缕金色的阳光穿透薄雾和远处树叶的缝隙，在他们身上和草地上投下温暖而柔和的光斑。这对夫妇面容祥和，表情专注，他们的动作完美同步且极其缓慢，身体微微下沉，双臂以一种优雅而对称的姿态稳定而从容地划过空气，每一个转身、每一次重心转移都显得毫不费力，仿佛与周围的自然融为一体，真正做到了行云流水。整个画面充满了宁静、和谐与生命力的气息，在冷色调的绿色背景与暖色调的晨光交织下，营造出一种专注而安详的沉思氛围。
prompt: static, long shot, shot from a level angle, quietly captures a tranquil moment of early morning in a park. In the center of the frame, an elderly couple, their hair completely gray, stand on a lush green lawn. Clad in loose, flowing white silk Tai Chi robes, they stand out against the morning light. The morning mist has not yet fully dissipated, shrouding the air in a delicate, soft veil. The first rays of golden sunlight penetrate the mist and the gaps between the distant leaves, casting a warm, soft glow on them and the grass. The couple's faces are serene and focused, their movements perfectly synchronized and incredibly slow. Their bodies dip slightly, their arms gliding through the air with a graceful, symmetrical gesture, steady and deliberate. Each turn and shift of weight appears effortless, as if they are one with the surrounding nature, a truly fluid movement. The entire scene is imbued with tranquility, harmony, and vitality. The interplay of the cool green background and the warm morning light creates an atmosphere of focused and serene contemplation.

prompt_cn: 一个极致的微距特写镜头，采用极低的平视角度，模拟紧贴地面的第一人称视野，相机保持绝对静止，聚焦于一个形似光滑彩色卵石的日轮玉，其表面呈现出斑驳的灰绿色与淡紫色纹理，质感饱满而富有肉质感。突然，在日轮玉饱满的对生叶片中央，一道细微的裂缝毫无征兆地出现，并迅速而无声地向两侧扩展开来，一株极其娇嫩的翠绿色新芽便从裂缝中小心翼翼地、一寸一寸地奋力向上顶出。这株新芽的表皮上布满了几乎看不见的细腻纵向纹理，无数微小的、晶莹剔透的水珠凝结其上，在明亮而柔和的漫射光下如同钻石般闪烁。背景被极致的浅景深完全虚化，呈现出一片柔和、均匀的亮白色，消除了任何粗糙的阴影，进一步突出了主体。整个画面纯净无瑕，色调清新自然，充满了对新生萌发的敬畏感和微观世界的神奇之美，营造出一种宁静、纯粹且充满生命力的氛围。
prompt: An extreme macro close-up shot, captured from an extremely low, level angle, simulating a ground-level first-person perspective, the camera remains absolutely still, focused on a sunflower resembling a smooth, multicolored pebble. Its surface displays mottled gray-green and lavender veins, giving it a rich, fleshy texture. Suddenly, without warning, a fine crack appears in the center of the sunflower's plump, opposite leaves, rapidly and silently spreading to either side. From this crack, a delicate, emerald green sprout cautiously and forcefully pushes upward, inch by inch. The sprout's surface is covered in fine, almost invisible vertical veins, etched with countless tiny, crystal-clear water droplets, shimmering like diamonds in the bright, soft, diffuse light. The background, completely blurred by the extremely shallow depth of field, reveals a soft, uniform, brilliant white, eliminating any harsh shadows and further highlighting the subject. The entire picture is pure and flawless, with fresh and natural colors. It is full of awe for new growth and the magical beauty of the microscopic world, creating a tranquil, pure and vital atmosphere.

prompt_cn: 一个极具冲击力的仰拍镜头，镜头缓慢而稳定地向前推进，聚焦于一名扎着紧致黑色双丸子头的少年，他正站在惊涛骇浪的悬崖之巅。他赤着上身，仅在胸前系着一件莲花刺绣的红色肚兜，一条鲜红如血的混天绫如活物般缠绕在他的肩臂之上，在狂风中不受控制地狂舞。背景是密布天空的、翻滚不休的铅灰色乌云，偶尔划破天际的惨白闪电，为这幅末日般的景象提供了唯一的光源，每一次闪光都在他紧绷的肌肉和愤怒到扭曲的脸庞上雕刻出深刻的光影。他猛地将头向后仰去，脖颈上的青筋因极致的用力而暴起，双眼圆睁，瞳孔中燃烧着不屈的怒火，嘴巴张到最大，正对着压抑的天空发出一场无声却撼天动地的愤怒吼叫，其身体因巨大的情绪张力而微微颤抖，营造出一种神话般的、与天地抗争的悲壮与决绝氛围。
prompt: powerful overhead shot, the camera slowly and steadily pans forward, focusing on a young man with tight black buns standing atop a raging cliff.
